title: betterpeople A/S is recruiting on behalf of CSIS Security Group for an Account Manager.
description:
Account Manager, CSIS Security Group
Are you motivated by building strong customer relationships and creating new business opportunities in a market with growing demand? This is an opportunity to join one of the Nordic region’s leading cybersecurity specialists and play a central role in its continued growth journey.

CSIS Security Group 
CSIS is a leading cybersecurity specialist with a strong Nordic foundation and international reach. The company continues to grow at a pace that exceeds the market year after year, helping organisations prevent, detect, and respond to cyber threats in a world where security has never been more critical. 

Since its establishment in 2001, CSIS has built a strong market position through deep expertise, uncompromising quality, and close customer relationships. Today, the company serves as a trusted advisor to both private and public sector organisations seeking specialist cybersecurity expertise. 

The culture is defined by ambition, collaboration, and a strong belief that the best results are achieved together. People work closely across the organisation, support one another, and share both successes and challenges. At the same time, there is a high degree of autonomy, short decision-making processes, and plenty of opportunities to make a meaningful impact. 

Based at CSIS’ headquarters in Copenhagen, this role offers the opportunity to work alongside some of the industry’s leading specialists in an ambitious and fast-growing organisation. 

The Role as Account Manager 
As Account Manager, you will play a key role in CSIS’ continued growth journey. You will be responsible for developing and strengthening relationships with both new and existing customers while acting as an important ambassador for the company’s services and expertise in the market. 

The role combines new business development with strategic account management, giving you ownership of the entire sales process – from initial dialogue and needs assessment to negotiation, contract signing, and the long-term development of customer relationships. You will work closely with CSIS’ technical specialists and consultants to ensure customers receive the high level of quality and advisory services for which the company is known. 

In a world where organisations can no longer rest assured that traditional security measures are enough, cybersecurity has become a strategic priority for executive teams and boards alike. As a trusted advisor, you will help customers understand their risks, strengthen their security posture, and make informed decisions in an increasingly complex threat landscape. 

The role offers a high degree of autonomy and responsibility, providing an excellent opportunity to influence both your own success and the continued growth of the business. 

You bring 
You are a commercially driven professional with experience from cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, or a related technology environment. Building relationships, identifying new opportunities, and turning them into tangible business results, comes naturally to you. 

The ideal candidate has a proven track record in complex B2B sales and is comfortable engaging with both technical and business stakeholders. At the same time, you are recognised for your ability to build trust, understand customer challenges, and translate their needs into value-creating solutions. 

You work in a structured and goal-oriented manner, take ownership of your responsibilities, and thrive in an environment where collaboration, expertise, and ambition go hand in hand. 

Experience from the cybersecurity industry is an advantage, but equally important is a strong commercial mindset, the ability to navigate complex sales environments, and a genuine passion for building long-term customer relationships. 

Why Join CSIS? 
This is a unique opportunity to become part of a company characterised by strong growth, ambitious goals, and a willingness to invest in both people and business development. 

You will join an organisation operating in a market with growing demand and increasing strategic importance, working alongside some of the industry's most skilled specialists while representing a strong brand in the cybersecurity sector. 

For the right candidate, this is a rare opportunity to combine commercial success with a central role in a company that continues its ambitious growth journey. 

The Recruitment Process is Managed by betterpeople A/S
As the position is to be filled as soon as possible, applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis. However, we are willing to wait for the right candidate. 

If you have any questions regarding the position, please contact Sine Fæste at sfm@betterpeople.dk. All applications and enquiries will be treated with complete confidentiality and discretion. 

In accordance with data protection regulations, applications are accepted only via the application link on our website. If you experience difficulties submitting your application, please do not hesitate to contact us. 

Please note that our advertisements are automatically and continuously renewed on job portals until the position has been filled. A renewed advertisement should therefore not be interpreted as a reposting of the position, even if it may appear so. 

© betterpeople A/S

title: Vil du være den reparatør, der gør en synlig forskel i produktionen?
description:
Hos Rul-let handler vedligehold ikke kun om at holde maskinerne i gang – men om at finde de løsninger, der gør hverdagen lettere, driften stærkere og produktionen endnu bedre. Hvis du trives med ansvar, teknik og frihed til at tænke selv, er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos Rul-let producerer vi emballage til fødevarer, som bruges i både supermarkeder og industrikøkkener verden over. Vi er i gang med at opgradere vores tekniske setup og søger én ny kollega til vedligeholdelsesteamet med interesse for el, automatik, mekanik og maskinoptimering.

Uanset om du er mest til strøm eller stål, er det vigtigste, at du brænder for teknik, tager ansvar og har lyst til at se dine idéer blive til virkelighed. Du bliver en del af et lille team, hvor vi har ansvar for hver vores linjer, men aldrig står alene. Vi hjælper hinanden, deler erfaringer og lytter til gode forslag – også når de kommer fra værkstedsgulvet.

Dine opgaver

  • Vedligeholde og fejlfinde på mekanisk, elektrisk og pneumatisk udstyr

  • Skifte mellem produkter og materialer i produktionen

  • Bygge og optimere maskindele – gerne med dine egne løsninger

  • Bidrage med input, når vi investerer i nye maskiner og smartere løsninger

Du arbejder primært på daghold ca. 7.00 – 15.00, men du kan forvente aften- og weekendvagt ca. hver 4. uge, hvor weekendvagter er som tilkald. Til gengæld hjælper vi hinanden med bytning af vagter og fridage, så hverdagen også kan hænge sammen uden for arbejdet.

Hvem er du?
Du har hænderne skruet rigtigt på og trives med ansvar. Du er nysgerrig, løsningsorienteret og går op i, at tingene virker – både i dag og i morgen. Måske har du en baggrund som automatiktekniker, elektriker, industritekniker, smed eller lignende, men vigtigst er, at du:

  • Har erfaring med automatiserede anlæg og teknisk vedligehold

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og samtidig være en god kollega

  • Taler dansk og forstår engelsk

  • Har lyst til at gøre en forskel – hver dag

Det tilbyder vi

  • En hverdag med variation, ansvar og tekniske udfordringer

  • Gode kolleger, en uformel tone og et team, hvor vi hjælper hinanden

  • Frihed til at tænke nyt – og mulighed for at blive hørt, når du har en god idé

  • Et stærkt team og en chef, der selv har hænderne i maskinerne

  • Kantineordning og gratis adgang til fitnesscenter

  • Mulighed for fleksibel planlægning af ferie og fridage, når driften tillader det

Er du klar til at blive en del af holdet?
Så send din ansøgning og CV snarest. Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette.

Har du spørgsmål til jobbet, er du velkommen til at kontakte vedligeholdelseschef Preben Hansen på 5158 1749.

Vi glæder os til at byde dig velkommen.

Vi søger dig, der

  • Trives i et miljø, hvor tempoet er højt, og hvor kvalitet aldrig kompromitteres

  • Har en naturlig autoritet og formår at skabe ro, retning og motivation omkring dig

  • Kommunikerer klart, professionelt og nærværende

  • Har øje for detaljer og en stærk forståelse for, hvad førsteklasses service kræver

  • Er ambitiøs, driftssikker og klar til at tage ansvar for både mennesker og processer

Vi tilbyder

  • En nøgleposition i en af Københavns mest spektakulære restauranter

  • En del af en kvalitetsdrevet koncern med høje standarder og stærke værdier

  • Et professionelt team med stor faglighed og ambition

  • En kultur, hvor medarbejdertrivsel, kvalitet og udvikling vægtes højt

  • Karriere- og udviklingsmuligheder i en organisation i vækst

  • En konkurrencedygtig lønpakke og ordentlige arbejdsvilkår

Om dig

Du bevæger dig med både overblik og beslutsomhed.
Du er løsningsorienteret, struktureret og stærk i din kommunikation.
Du trives i rollen som leder og er motiveret af at udvikle både mennesker og drift.
Du bringer professionalisme, ansvarlighed og en passion for service ind i alt, hvad du gør.

Praktisk

Stillingen er på fuld tid med opstart hurtigst muligt – men vi venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

If you enjoy freedom with responsibility as well as working in the quiet of the night while others sleep, we would love to have you on board.

At dao, you will get:

  • A flexible night job with around 32 hours per week

  • Good training from day one and a supportive community

  • Piecework pay as you deliver newspapers, letters, magazines and parcels by bike, scooter or car.

  • Salary and conditions in accordance with the agreement with the workers union 3F


We deliver every night and all year

As a Danish delivery company, dao brings newspapers, letters, magazines, and parcels to people all over the country 365 days a year.

Even though you will be working on your own, you will never feel alone. Because your manager and the rest of your team is there for you.


Deliver at night while others sleep

Before you start, you will receive training to feel confident in your role. You will also by supported by an experienced colleague, and your manager will check in with you to make sure you are settling in well.

During your shift you will:

  • Pack your bike, scooter or car with newspapers, letters, parcels and magazines. 

  • Follow your route and deliver to doors and mailboxes

  • Keep a good pace and meet deadlines


Not a resident? Not a problem!

If you do not live in Denmark, we will help you get settled. Because we know moving to a new country is not easy. During the interview we will tell you much more.


You enjoy working at night in all kinds of weather, and you:

  • Are steady, responsible, and deliver with care and accuracy

  • Can speak either English and/or Danish 

Ready to become our newest night owl?

title: Freelance underviser og konsulent  søges til SydJylland
description:
Freelance formidler, underviser og konsulent søges til IFMT

Har du faglighed, formidlingsevner og lyst til at gøre en forskel for andre? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter.

Hos IFMT arbejder vi med noget helt grundlæggende for mennesker, organisationer og samfund: tillid.

Vi kan have tillid til os selv. Vi kan skabe tillid mellem mennesker. Organisationer kan være præget af mere eller mindre tillid – og hele samfund kan være bygget på tillid eller mistillid.

Det perspektiv tager vi med ind i vores undervisning, kompetenceudvikling og konsulentarbejde.

Vi oplever stigende efterspørgsel

Hos IFMT oplever vi en stigende efterspørgsel på undervisning, læring og kompetenceudvikling i hele landet.

Derfor søger vi dygtige freelance undervisere, formidlere og konsulenter, primært til Horsens–Esbjerg–Fyn og omegn, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores faglige fællesskab.

Vi søger blandt andet profiler med stærke kompetencer inden for:

  • IT og digitale kompetencer

  • Fotografi

  • Andre relevante fagområder, hvor du har stærk faglighed og noget værdifuldt at give videre

Din faglighed skal kunne mærkes – men også forstås

Faglig viden er vigtig. Men hos IFMT tror vi på, at den gode underviser kan mere end sit fag.

Du kan omsætte din viden til læring, der giver mening for mennesker med forskellige erfaringer, behov og forudsætninger.

Du er en stærk formidler, der:

  • gør komplekse emner forståelige og relevante

  • skaber engagement og motivation

  • møder mennesker med respekt og anerkendelse

  • kan skabe et trygt læringsrum, hvor det er okay at stille spørgsmål

  • tilpasser undervisningen til forskellige målgrupper

  • har blik for både det faglige og det menneskelige

  • brænder for at se andre mennesker udvikle sig

Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis være klassisk underviser af profession. Måske er du konsulent, freelancer eller specialist inden for dit fagområde. Måske har du mange års erhvervserfaring og har lyst til at prøve kræfter med undervisning.

Det vigtigste for os er, at du har noget på hjerte, er dygtig til dit fag og har lyst til at dele din viden med andre.

Du bliver en del af noget større

Som freelance underviser og konsulent hos IFMT bliver du en del af et fagligt fællesskab, hvor kvalitet, tillid og gode relationer er centrale værdier.

Vi tror ikke på, at god undervisning blot handler om at overføre viden fra én person til en anden.

Vi tror på, at god undervisning handler om at skabe engagement, åbne nye muligheder og give mennesker mod og kompetencer til at tage næste skridt.

Det er dét, vi gerne vil have dig med til.

Har vi fanget din interesse?

Så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

Send en kort beskrivelse af dig selv, din faglighed og dine erfaringer – og fortæl gerne, hvad du brænder for at lære fra dig.

Skriv – ikke ring – til Dag Njaa Isene på:
dag@ifmt.dk

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

IFMT – fordi læring begynder med tillid.

title: Software Specialist — Embedded Systems & Mobile Applications
description:
About Wahl & Ross ApS

Wahl & Ross ApS is an established Danish product development company, registered under CVR no. 33069782 with offices at Nordre Fasanvej 215, 2000

Frederiksberg. We take products from early concept to manufactured reality — hardware, firmware and the software around it. We currently have between five and ten projects running in parallel, split between our own product development and work carried out for external clients across consumer, industrial and medical categories. We are a small, senior team and work in short, direct feedback loops.

The role

We are looking for an experienced software specialist to join our team in Copenhagen full time. Software and firmware is your core discipline, and you also

bring hands-on knowledge of robotics from previous work. Your main areas of responsibility will be:

  • Software and firmware development for our embedded product platforms

  • Mobile applications connecting to our devices

  • Software for robotics: motion control, sensor integration and realtime behaviour

  • Bring-up, debugging and testing on physical prototypes

  • Technical documentation of your work

  • Close collaboration with our hardware and design teams

What we are looking for

  • A software specialist first: several years of documented professional experience in software and firmware development, including C/C++ on microcontrollers

  • Solid knowledge of and hands-on experience with robotics — control, sensors, actuators and real-time constraints

  • Experience with mobile application development for iOS and/or Android, including device connectivity such as BLE

  • Comfortable taking ownership of your own deliverables and deadlines

  • Professional working proficiency in English

  • Able to work on-site at our office in Copenhagen (Nordre Fasanvej 215, 2000 Frederiksberg) during agreed working hours

  • A team player who enjoys working closely with hardware, design and mechanical engineers day to day

What we offer

  • A permanent, full-time position in an established company

  • Real influence on your own working methods, tools and technical choices

  • Varied technical work across hardware, firmware and software on products that reach the market

  • A well-equipped workshop and lab at our Copenhagen office, with prototypes on the bench

  • A small, senior team, short decision paths and direct access to the people who make them

  • Salary and pension agreed on the basis of skills and experience, and employment terms in line with Danish standards

How to apply

Send your CV and a short description of relevant projects to

soren@wahlross.studio with the subject line “Software Specialist — Embedded/Robotics”.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis and must be received no later than 1 September 2026. The advertisement is taken down as soon as the right candidate has been found.

Questions may be directed to Wahl & Ross on +45 53 87 21 11.

At a glance

  • Permanent employment, full time (37 hours per week)

  • Working hours Mon–Fri, 09:00–17:00 CET/CEST

  • Salary Based on skills and experience

  • Workplace On-site, Nordre Fasanvej 215, 2000 Frederiksberg, Copenhagen

  • Start As soon as possible

  • Deadline 1 October 2026, or until the position is filled

  • Apply to soren@wahlross.studio

title: Lastvognsmekaniker - Padborg
description:
Skifter Lastbil A/S søger en lastvognsmekaniker med hænderne skruet rigtig på til vores værksted i Padborg.

Om jobbet

Som lastvognsmekaniker hos Skifter Lastbil får du en alsidig hverdag med fokus på høj kvalitet og stærkt samarbejde.

Dine primære arbejdsopgaver vil omfatte alle former for fejlsøgning, reparationer og serviceeftersyn på lastbiler.

Du bliver en del af et engageret team på 28 medarbejdere, fordelt på værksted og kontor, hvor kunden altid er i centrum, og hjælpen fra dine fagligt dygtige kolleger altid er tæt på.

Vi har skiftende arbejdstider, herunder aften/lørdag, som du også bliver omfattet af.

Dine kvalifikationer

  • Kendskab til branchen – og har en uddannelse som lastvognsmekaniker, landbrugsmaskin-mekaniker eller lignende.

  • Du er alsidig, idet arbejdsopgaverne ligger indenfor flere områder.

  • Det er en fordel - men ikke et krav, at du har god erfaring med svejsning, el, hydraulik eller pneumatik.

  • Du er indstillet på en varieret og travl hverdag og kan håndtere flere bolde i luften på en gang.

  • Du er uddannelsesparat og ønsker fortsat en udvikling indenfor branchen.

Vi Tilbyder

  • Ansættelse i en virksomhed med en god og sund økonomi samt gode og ordnede arbejdsforhold.

  • Vi tilbyder gode personalevilkår, herunder sundhedssikring og pensionsordning

  • Et spændende job med mange udfordringer, hvor du selv kan præge din arbejdsdag.

  • Udviklingsmulighed i takt med din kompetence og interesse via efteruddannelse ved Volvo og Renault.

  • Gode arbejdskollegaer og et godt kollegialt sammenhold.

Om os

Skifter Lastbil A/S er en af Danmarks største lastvognsforhandlere med 6 afdelinger i henholdsvis Herning, Aabenraa, Padborg, Holstebro, Viborg og Esbjerg som forhandler og servicerer Volvo og Renault lastbiler. Vi er privatejet og kendetegnes ved en flad og uhøjtidelig organisation, hvor der ikke er langt fra tanke til handling. Vi brænder for at gøre en forskel og forsøger hele tiden at udvikle os, så vi i fællesskab kan skabe den bedste oplevelse i hverdagen, for både kunder og medarbejdere.

Dit næste skridt
Er du vores nye lastvognsmekaniker på værkstedet i Padborg?

Så ring til værkstedschef Dennis Heldt på telefon 8827 9399 og hør mere om arbejdsopgaverne og vores hverdag på værkstedet.

  • Tiltrædelse: Efter aftale.

  • Ansøgning: Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så tøv ikke med at række ud.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

title: Pladesmed/svejser søges til automotive virksomhed i Dragør
description:
Svejsning · CNC-bukning · Laserskæring – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Dragør, Danmark

Er du typen, der læser en tegning, starter maskinen og er stolt af det, der kommer ud i den anden ende? RENTEQ Automotive er en startup i vækst, og vi har brug for en dygtig smed til at hjælpe os med at bygge de rammer og kabinetter, der indgår i hvert eneste køretøj, vi konverterer. Hvis du er praktisk anlagt, nysgerrig og har lyst til at sætte dit præg på noget, der virkelig betyder noget – så læs videre.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Dragør og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Din rolle

Som vores smed vil du omsætte tegninger til de færdige dele, der går i vores produkter. Fra vores værksted i Dragør betjener du vores 8+1-akset CNC-kantbukningsmaskine, laserskærer og svejseudstyr til at fremstille de bærende rammer og kabinetter, der udgør rygraden i vores køretøjskonverteringer.

Det her er ikke et samlebånd – hvert projekt er anderledes, og du skal kunne tænke selvstændigt. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang.

Dine opgaver

•     Betjene den 8+1-aksede CNC-kantbukningsmaskine til at producere præcisionsbøjede rammer og konstruktionsdele

•     Opsætte og betjene laserskæreren til pladeemner, beslag og kabinetpaneler

•     Svejse bærende rammer, kasser og kabinetter – MIG og TIG afhængigt af materiale og specifikation

•     Læse og fortolke tekniske tegninger og omsætte dem til færdige dele

•     Kvalitetskontrollere eget arbejde – målkontrol, svejsekvalitet og pasform – inden det går til produktion

•     Samarbejde med ingeniørteamet om at identificere designproblemer og give praktisk feedback

•     Holde værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret

•     Understøtte prototypeiterationer – forvent at der er hyppige designændringer og flere projekter kørende på én gang.


Er det dig, vi leder efter?

Har du praktisk erfaring inden for svejs/smedearbejde – det kan være fra en håndværksuddannelse, teknisk skole eller reel værkstedserfaring?

Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan sætte kryds ved det meste af nedenstående:

•     Erfaren svejser – MIG er et krav, TIG er et stort plus

•     Fortrolig med CNC-bukningsmaskiner; erfaring med fleraksede bukkemaskiner er ideelt

•     Erfaring med laserskæring – opsætning, nesting og sikker betjening

•     I stand til at læse og arbejde ud fra tekniske tegninger og 3D-modeller

•     Øje for detaljen: du måler to gange og er stolt af præcist, pænt arbejde

•     Trives i et team, hvor ingen dage er ens

•     Proaktiv – du identificerer problemer tidligt frem for at lade dem blive til andres problem

•     Dansk på højt niveau og velfungerende engelsk, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

•     En central rolle i en startup i vækst, hvor dit arbejde er synligt i hvert køretøj, der forlader vores værksted

•     Et uformelt og rart team i en flad virksomhedsstruktur med variation i arbejdsdagene

•     Et sundt og attraktivt arbejdsmiljø med moderne fabrikationsudstyr

•     Ordentlige faciliteter i Dragør med god adgang i bil og med offentlig transport

•     Reelle muligheder for at vokse med virksomheden, efterhånden som vi skalerer til fuld produktion.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme e-mailadresse, som angivet ovenfor.

title: 2 Mekanikere/montører søges til spændende automotive virksomhed i Dragør – konverteringer
description:
Konverteringsforberedelse fra brændstof til el · Praktisk udvikling – Fuldtid, fysisk tilstedeværelse, Dragør, Danmark

RENTEQ Automotive søger efter to praktiske og dygtige mekanikere/montører, der kan tage hånd om de mekaniske aspekter af vores konverteringer til el, og som har det rette mindset til at arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor processerne løbende optimeres.

Om RENTEQ Automotive

RENTEQ Automotive er en ung dansk virksomhed med en ambition om at reducere CO₂-udledningen ved at elektrificere varebiler og entreprenørmaskiner. Vi holder til i Dragør og tager hele rejsen på os – fra ingeniørarbejde og udvikling helt frem til produktion.

Jobbet

Som mekaniker/montør hos os arbejder du med den praktiske del af konverteringerne – at forberede og demontere maskiner og køretøjer, så de er klar til elektrificering.

Konverteringerne foregår ikke på samlebånd – hvert projekt er anderledes. Du arbejder tæt sammen med ingeniør- og produktionsteamet, kan finde ud af bidrage til problemløsninger tidligt, og hjælper os med at bygge klogere fra gang til gang. Du er med til at sikre, at hver eneste komponent behandles korrekt og dokumenteres præcist, idet dit arbejde er fundamentet for hele konverteringsprojektet.

Dine typiske opgaver vil være:

●      Afmontering af motor og brændstofdel – med fokus på korrekt håndtering og dokumentation

●      Forberedelse af chassis og karosseri til montering af nye elektriske komponenter

●      Tilpasning af komponenter efter konvertering i tæt samarbejde med elektronik- og software-teamet

●      Kvalitetskontrol og dokumentation af alle monteringssteps og fund under demontering

●      Løbende forbedring af proces og arbejdsgange – du kan bidrage til de guider og checklister, vi udvikler

●      Arbejde med varierede maskiner og køretøjer – fra små varebiler til store entreprenørmaskiner

●      Sammen holder vi altid værkstedet organiseret, udstyr vedligeholdt og processer dokumenteret for at sikre den højest mulige kvalitet.

Er det dig?

Vi leder efter en person med solid praktisk erfaring og en tilgang, der kombinerer præcision med fleksibilitet. Vigtigst er, at du kan arbejde selvstændigt, men også er dygtig til at samarbejde i et team, der hele tiden lærer og udvikler sig. Det vil være en fordel, hvis du kan nikke ja til nedenstående:

●      Erfaring med montering og demontering af motor, hydrauliksystem og brændstofkomponenter på landbrugsmaskiner, entreprenørmaskiner eller varebiler

●      Solidt kendskab til mekaniske systemer, væskesystemer og elektriske grundelementer

●      Ideelt set erfaring med eller stærk interesse for konverteringer og ombygninger

●      AC-kursus eller tilsvarende (ikke obligatorisk, men en stor fordel)

●      Evnen til at arbejde struktureret og dokumentere dit arbejde

●      Selvstændighed og ansvar, men også åbenhed over for feedback og samarbejde

●      Tålmodighed og en positiv tilgang til arbejde i et udviklingsmiljø, hvor vi hele tiden forfiner processen

●      Dansk på højt niveau; fungerende engelsk er en fordel, da vi er et internationalt team.

Vi tilbyder

●      En central rolle i vores udviklingsteam, hvor din praktiske viden sætter direkte aftryk på, hvordan vi konverterer

●      Mulighed for at påvirke og udforme arbejdsprocesserne – dine idéer og erfaringer bliver hørt

●      Varieret hverdag med arbejde på en bred vifte af køretøjer og maskiner

●      Tæt samarbejde med dygtige ingeniører og et uformelt, kollegialt team

●      Ordentlige faciliteter, godt værktøj og en støttende arbejdskultur

●      Løn: 190-240 kr./t afhængig af kompetencer og erfaring

●      Reelle muligheder for at vokse fagligt og personligt i takt med, at virksomheden udvikler sig.

Sådan søger du

Send dit CV og et par linjer om dig selv til Simon Steen Kristensen på email simon@ren-teq.com. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende og inviterer relevante kandidater til en uformel første samtale – så vent ikke for længe med at tage kontakt.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, inden du søger, er du meget velkommen til at skrive til os på samme e-mailadresse, som angivet ovenfor.

title: Praktiske medarbejdere søges til Dencker Group
description:
Vi får mere at lave og søger derfor flere stabile og praktisk anlagte folk, som har lyst til at blive en del af Dencker Group.

De fleste af vores opgaver er fysisk krævende i større eller mindre grad. Du skal derfor være indstillet på et arbejde, hvor man er aktiv, arbejder udendørs og bruger kroppen i løbet af dagen.

Erfaring fra eksempelvis anlæg, entreprenørarbejde, landbrug, ejendomsservice, grøn drift eller håndværk er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er vant til praktisk og fysisk arbejde

  • Møder stabilt og tager ansvar for dine opgaver

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt eller sammen med andre

  • Passer på maskiner og udstyr

  • Er ordentlig over for kunder og kollegaer

  • Kan se, hvad der skal laves og tager fat

Kørekort B er en stor fordel. Trailerkørekort, maskinerfaring eller relevante certifikater er også en fordel.

Timer og ansættelse

Vi har brug for forskellige typer medarbejdere og er derfor åbne for flere løsninger.

Det kan eksempelvis være:

description:
International Construction Manager Wanted at DK TØMRER

Do you have an international degree in construction management, architectural technology, civil engineering, building engineering, or a related field – and are you looking to develop your career in the Danish construction industry?

DK TØMRER is looking for a motivated and well-organised International Construction Manager to help manage and coordinate our construction projects across Zealand.

We are a growing construction company working on both large-scale contracts and ongoing construction and renovation projects. We are therefore looking for someone who can help ensure structure, quality, coordination, and progress across our construction sites.

Your Responsibilities

As a Construction Manager, your responsibilities will include:

  • Daily coordination and follow-up on construction sites

  • Planning and coordination of employees and subcontractors

  • Quality assurance and photographic documentation

  • Monitoring schedules, deadlines, and project progress

  • Ordering materials and coordinating deliveries

  • Communicating with project managers, main contractors, and other project partners

  • Reviewing drawings, specifications, and other project documentation

  • Registering and managing additional works and variations

  • Participating in construction and project meetings

  • Monitoring health and safety, quality standards, and site safety

About You

We are looking for someone with a degree in Construction Management, Architectural Technology and Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Building Engineering, or a similar field, preferably obtained outside Denmark.

For us, the most important thing is not where you obtained your education, but that you have a solid understanding of construction, are willing to take responsibility, and are motivated to learn and develop within the Danish construction industry.

You work in a structured manner, are able to maintain an overview in a busy construction-site environment, and communicate effectively with both tradespeople and project management.

The ability to communicate in English is important. Danish language skills are an advantage, but Danish does not need to be your native language.

What We Offer

At DK TØMRER, you will become part of a growing company with short decision-making processes and the opportunity to take on significant responsibility.

We offer:

  • An exciting position involving a variety of construction projects

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

title: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

  • Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

  • Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

  • Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

  • Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

  • Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

  • Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

  • Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

  • Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

  • Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

  • Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

  • Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

  • Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

  • Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

  • A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

  • Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Terminal Worker Wanted for Night Shift in Greve
description:
Do you thrive on night work, fixed routines, and physical tasks? Then you might be the one we are looking for to join the night shift at a terminal in Greve.

At our client’s terminal in Greve, logistics and distribution of parcels and goods are handled daily. Parcels are received, sorted, and forwarded into the distribution network to ensure they efficiently reach their recipients.

The night shift consists of approximately 20 employees who work closely together in a busy environment. There is a strong team spirit, with colleagues from different backgrounds and levels of experience contributing to a positive and supportive working atmosphere.

The work is routine-based and requires focus and structure. Your tasks will include:

  • Opening pallets and placing parcels on conveyor belts

  • Scanning parcels at the sorting line

  • Sorting parcels into the correct cages according to assigned numbers

  • Ensuring a stable and efficient sorting flow

The work is performed standing up and is physically demanding. You must be prepared for repeated lifting, frequent movement, and handling parcels that can be quite heavy.

We are looking for someone with a strong work ethic who thrives in physically demanding work and structured routines. You work efficiently and can maintain a steady pace, even during the early morning hours when energy levels are tested. At the same time, you are able to stay focused on repetitive tasks and take initiative if there are pauses in operations, for example by cleaning up or handling other practical tasks. Experience from similar work is an advantage but not a requirement. The most important qualities are reliability, a sense of responsibility, and readiness to take initiative.

You will be employed in a temporary position with the possibility of permanent employment if the match is right and there is an ongoing need. Working hours are typically from 11:00 PM to 6:30 AM, starting Sunday night and finishing the week Saturday morning. The hourly wage is DKK 190.96 in accordance with the collective agreement, plus night shift supplements.

Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Then send your application today, we look forward to hearing from you.

title: People Analytics & Rewards Specialist
employer: Impact Fund Denmark (tidl. Investeringsfonden for Udviklingslande)
description:
As Impact Fund Denmark continues to grow and professionalise, we want more of our people and organisational decisions to be grounded in evidence, data and a clear understanding of what drives behaviour and performance.

That is why we are creating a new role at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent.

You might already work in HR and be looking to build deeper analytical expertise. Or you may come from organisational psychology, economics, analytics or a related field and want to apply your skills in a People & Culture setting.

Either way, what matters most is that you are curious about how organisations work, comfortable working with data, and able to turn analysis into useful insights and practical recommendations and that you take pride in contributing and getting things to impact.

You will report to our Head of People & Culture.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Your role is to help us understand our organisation better — and use that understanding to make better decisions.

Your work will span analytics, reward and talent. You will:

  • Analyse employee, performance, engagement, talent and compensation data

  • Turn data and research into clear conclusions and practical recommendations for People & Culture and management

  • Support compensation benchmarking and our annual salary and compensation processes

  • Contribute to the implementation of the EU Pay Transparency requirements, including the related analysis and reporting

  • Develop dashboards, recurring People reporting and metrics that help us focus on what matters

  • Analyse engagement survey results and help turn them into meaningful organisational actions

  • Support talent, succession and performance processes with analysis and insight

  • Bring relevant research from organisational psychology and behavioural science into the way we design and evaluate People initiatives

  • Challenge assumptions and help us understand whether our interventions are having the intended effect

  • Prepare clear presentations and decision material for colleagues and leadership

  • Contribute to selected organisational development and talent projects

YOUR FIRST YEAR

By the end of your first year, we would expect to see progress in five areas:

  • Data: our People reporting and analytics are clearer, more consistent and more useful

  • Reward: compensation processes are supported by reliable analysis and relevant market data

  • Listening: employee survey data is translated into meaningful insights rather than simply reported

  • Evidence: important People initiatives increasingly have a clear evidence base, purpose and intended outcome

  • Decision support: People & Culture and leadership receive concise, relevant analysis that helps them make better decisions

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

This is what we need to see:

  • A relevant academic background, for example in psychology, organisational psychology, economics, business, HR, statistics or another analytical discipline

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills

  • A few years of relevant professional experience. We care more about the quality and relevance of your experience than an exact number of years

  • Strong Excel skills and confidence working with data

  • The ability to move from data or research to a clear conclusion and a practical recommendation

  • Intellectual curiosity and a genuine interest in understanding why People practices work — rather than simply following established practice

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Professional fluency in English

These would be advantages, but they are not requirements:

  • Previous HR experience

  • Experience with Compensation & Benefits or Reward

  • Experience with People Analytics, employee surveys or HR reporting

  • Knowledge of statistics or research methodology

  • Experience with Power BI or similar visualisation tools

  • Experience applying organisational psychology or behavioural science in an organisational setting

  • Emotional intelligence, active listening and the ability to stay neutral under pressure

  • Courage to address uncomfortable issues, strong mediation and conflict-resolution capability

  • Professional fluency in Danish

WHERE THE ROLE SITS

This is an individual-contributor role within People & Culture.

You will work closely with the Head of People & Culture and with colleagues responsible for People Partnering, Operations and Recruitment.

Your role is to bring analytical depth and an evidence-based perspective to the areas where it can improve our decisions — particularly Reward, Talent, engagement and organisational development.

The scope is intentionally broad enough for you to grow and develop, but the professional core is clear: using data and evidence to improve people and organisational decisions.

WHY JOIN US

This is an opportunity to:

  • Help build a new capability at the intersection of People Analytics, Reward and Talent

  • Work closely with the Head of People & Culture and colleagues across the function

  • Apply data, research and behavioural science to real organisational questions

  • Build broad experience across compensation, talent, engagement and organisational development

  • Work in an organisation where the People agenda connects to a wider purpose: our colleagues support investments in green energy and infrastructure, financial services, sustainable food systems and healthcare in developing countries

PRACTICAL DETAILS

  • Location: Østbanegade 135, 2100 Copenhagen Ø

  • Position: Permanent, full-time, 39 hours per week including lunch

  • Hybrid: We currently have up to 20% of working time from home. We aim for first 6 months of employment to be in office for successful onboarding and integration into team and organisation.

  • Application deadline: 23 September 2026

Please apply through our talent platform. Applications submitted outside the platform will not be considered.

We review applications on an ongoing basis.

About Impact Fund Denmark

Impact Fund Denmark (IFU – the Investment Fund for Developing Countries) is a Danish impact investor contributing to green, just and inclusive societies as well as supporting the Sustainable Development Goals. Impact Fund Denmark provides risk capital to companies operating in developing countries across Africa, Asia, Latin America and parts of Europe. Investments are made on commercial terms in the form of equity, loans and guarantees. Impact Fund Denmark has co-invested in over 1,300 companies in more than 100 developing countries and emerging markets. Contracted investments total EUR 31 billion, of which Impact Fund Denmark has contributed EUR 3.4 billion. Capital under management will be growing from EUR 2.1 billion to EUR 5.0 billion over the next few years. Read more at Impact Fund Denmark

title: Part-time Administrative Officer for the Centre for Industrial Mechanics
description:
The Faculty of Engineering at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for a part-time Administrative Officer position at the Centre for Industrial Mechanics (CIM), part of the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at the SDU Sønderborg campus.

We are looking for a structured and proactive colleague who can support the Centre’s day-to-day administration, assist with project coordination, and contribute to the planning and organization of conferences, workshops, meetings and other academic and industrial events. The position offers the opportunity to work in an international university environment with close interaction with academic staff, students, external partners and administrative units.

Unique opportunity

The Centre for Industrial Mechanics combines research, education and collaboration with industry across areas including mechanical engineering, energy systems, renewable energy, artificial intelligence, mechatronics and related technologies. As the Centre continues to develop its activities and external collaborations, effective administrative and project support is important for ensuring smooth daily operations and successful delivery of events and projects.

The successful candidate will become part of an international and collaborative working environment and will have a varied portfolio of tasks. The role is well suited to a person who enjoys organizing, coordinating and communicating, and who is comfortable handling both routine administrative duties and changing priorities.

Workplace description

The Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering at SDU conducts research and education from fundamental engineering principles to applied solutions. The Centre for Industrial Mechanics is located in the Alsion building at SDU’s Sønderborg campus and benefits from strong connections with companies and organizations in Southern Denmark and Northern Germany. The working environment is international, and English is widely used in daily communication.

Duties of the position

  • Conference and Event Organization: Support the planning and practical organization of conferences, workshops, seminars, project meetings and other events. Tasks may include registration, participant communication, invitations, agendas, room coordination, catering, travel arrangements, accommodation, event materials and on-site support.

  • Daily Administrative Support: Assist with general administrative tasks for the Centre and its research groups, including correspondence, document preparation, meeting coordination, scheduling, filing, maintaining administrative records and following up on agreed actions.

  • Project Administration and Coordination: Support externally and internally funded projects with practical project-management tasks such as meeting planning, collection of inputs from partners, follow-up on deadlines and deliverables, preparation of simple status overviews, and coordination of project documentation.

  • Meeting Support: Organize internal and external meetings, prepare agendas and supporting material when required, take meeting notes or minutes, and assist with follow-up of decisions and action points.

  • Communication and Stakeholder Coordination: Communicate professionally with colleagues, students, project partners, companies, conference participants and other external stakeholders, and help ensure that relevant information is shared in a timely and structured manner.

  • Travel and Visit Coordination: Assist with practical arrangements for staff travel, guest visits, invited speakers and visiting researchers in accordance with SDU procedures.

  • Documentation and Information Management: Maintain structured project and administrative files, contact lists, event information, templates, presentations and other shared material, and support the collection and organization of information needed for reports and internal follow-up.

  • Financial and Procurement Support: Provide practical administrative assistance related to purchases, invoices, reimbursements, budgets and project expenses in coordination with the relevant SDU administrative functions. The role does not require responsibility for formal financial approval.

  • Other Administrative Tasks: Contribute flexibly to other administrative and organizational tasks that arise in the daily operation of the Centre and its projects.

We are seeking a reliable and motivated candidate with strong organizational and communication skills. The position does not require a specific advanced academic specialization; a relevant Bachelor’s or Master’s degree is sufficient.

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, management, communication, social sciences, humanities, engineering management, public administration, project management, or another relevant field.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several tasks, deadlines and stakeholders in parallel.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • A structured, responsible and service-oriented approach to administrative work.

  • Ability to work independently while also collaborating effectively with academic and administrative colleagues.

  • Good general digital skills, including confidence using common office applications such as Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook and Teams.

  • Attention to detail and the ability to handle information and documentation systematically.

It will be considered an advantage if you have

  • Previous experience with administration, event or conference organization, project coordination, or similar support functions.

  • Experience from a university, research organization, public institution or an international working environment.

  • Experience supporting externally funded projects or collaboration with companies and other external partners.

Personal qualifications

We value a colleague who is approachable, dependable and solution-oriented. You should enjoy creating structure, helping others and following tasks through to completion. Since the role involves interaction with many different people, we also expect you to communicate clearly and professionally and to handle changing priorities with flexibility.

The position is part-time with anticipated 12 hours per week. It is time limited to 1 year with the possibility for extension.

The exact weekly working hours and distribution of working time will be agreed in connection with the appointment. 

The workplace is Campus Soenderborg. 

Preferred starting date: As soon as possible. 

Further information

For further information about the position, please contact Associate Professor Lars Duggen, Centre for Industrial Mechanics, University of Southern Denmark, e-mail: duggen@sdu.dk.

Information about the Institute of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering and the Centre for Industrial Mechanics is available on SDU’s website.

Application procedure

Applications must be submitted electronically through SDU’s recruitment system. The application should include the following:

  • A motivated application describing your interest in the position and relevant experience.

  • Curriculum Vitae.

  • Documentation of relevant Bachelor’s and/or Master’s degree.

  • Any additional documentation that you consider relevant to the position.

Application deadline is September 24, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

Arbejdsopgaverne omfatter blandt andet klargøring af behandlingsrum, instrumenter og udstyr, assistance før, under og efter hårtransplantationsbehandlinger, praktisk hjælp ved håndtering og klargøring af grafts efter oplæring og instruktion, modtagelse og forberedelse af patienter, patientvejledning før og efter behandling samt lettere dokumentation og administrative opgaver.

Erfaring fra klinik, sundhedssektoren, kosmetiske behandlinger eller hårtransplantation er en fordel, men ikke et krav. Relevant oplæring vil blive tilbudt.

Copenhagen Private Clinic in Frederiksberg is looking for a motivated and responsible Clinical Assistant to join our team.

The position is full-time, 37 hours per week, and primarily involves practical and clinical assistance in connection with the clinic’s hair transplantation and hair restoration treatments.

The main responsibilities include preparation of treatment rooms, instruments and equipment, assistance before, during and after hair transplantation procedures, practical assistance with handling and preparation of grafts following training and instruction, preparation and reception of patients, practical patient guidance before and after treatment, as well as basic documentation and administrative tasks.

We are looking for someone who is responsible, detail-oriented and well organised, with good teamwork skills and an interest in clinical work and patient care. You should be motivated to learn new procedures and working methods and be able to work both independently and as part of a team.

title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
description:
About the position

Ferrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.

You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.

Your main responsibilities
  • Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.
  • Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.
  • Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.
  • Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.
  • Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.
  • Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.

  • Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.
  • Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance
  • Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.
  • Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.
  • Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.

Your professional background

Personal qualities

  • You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.

We offer

Practical information

Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.
Employment: Permanent position.

Application

title: Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor in Defense-related Technologies for Unmanned Aerial Systems Engineering for Defense
description:
SDU Drone Center at the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute (MMMI), University of Southern Denmark in Odense invites applications for positions in defense-related technologies for Drones (Unmanned Aerial Systems, UAS) at the levels of Full Professor, Associate Professor, or Assistant Professor. The positions are available from January 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

 

What we offer
The successful candidate(s) will join the SDU Drone Center, located at SDU Campus and at HCA Airport, where we operate state-of-the-art indoor and outdoor drone laboratories. You will become part of an interdisciplinary and agile research environment with strong ties to the internationally recognized robotics ecosystem in Odense.

 

What We expect
We expect candidates to have documented expertise in systems engineering for unmanned aerial systems with demonstrated real-world applications. The successful candidate will conduct research in aerial robotics, focusing on the design and implementation of drones operating in dynamic and complex outdoor environments. Relevant research areas include, but are not limited to, autonomous systems, swarming, navigation in GNSS-denied environments, communication and coordination, airspace situational awareness and management, safety and security, and counter-drone technologies.

Experience in defense-related research and/or applications is considered an advantage.

 

Commensurate with the seniority of the position applied for, the candidates must have:

  • Strong research and publication record;

  • Experience with defense, industrial, public sector and/or emergency services collaboration (this is a requirement for Full Professor);

  • Proven track record of attracting research funding (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor);

  • Experience with teaching and education development (this is a requirement for Full Professor and Associate Professor).

The successful candidate(s) are expected to play a proactive role in contributing to and expanding the Center’s research portfolio. This includes active participation in ongoing projects as well as the development, leadership, and coordination of new externally funded research initiatives. The candidate(s) are further expected to secure competitive national and international research funding, establish strategic collaborations with academic, industrial, and defense stakeholders, and strengthen the Center’s position in civil and defense-related drone technologies.

The candidate(s) will contribute to teaching and supervision within the Master of Science education in Drones and Autonomous Systems, which is part of the Robotics MSc programme at the University of Southern Denmark.

Research environment
SDU Drone Center conducts research in drone technologies and future drone applications within areas such as defense, infrastructure inspection, healthcare logistics, precision agriculture, nature conservation, and environmental monitoring. We are an interdisciplinary team of researchers with specializations within robotics, computer vision, software, embedded systems, and the design and construction of drone systems. Together we create drone solutions for a flourishing European society. Learn more about the center at https://www.sdu.dk/uasFor further information please contact Head of SDU Drone Center, Professor Ulrik Pagh Schultz, ups@mmmi.sdu.dk,  phone: +45 6550 3570.

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

Assessment of candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include: 

  • Motivated application.

  • Curriculum Vitae. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation). 

  • Complete list of publications.

  • Publications most relevant to the position.

  • Teaching Portfolio documenting teaching, learning, and supervision qualifications and approach. Any format is acceptable; see the Faculty's teaching portfolio page for inspiration (mandatory for full professor and associate professor applicants).

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience (for assistant professor applicants).

  • Research plan.

  • A statement/documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position may also be included.

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is November 15, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation. Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period, and appointment as an associate professor and full professor is permanent. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an associate professor and full professor requires academic qualifications at PhD level as well as scientific and teaching qualifications commensurate with the position as an associate professor or a full professor. A completed lecturer training programme or equivalent pedagogical/didactical competence development is a prerequisite. Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state included the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for assistant professor, associate professor or full professor as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

 

The University of Southern Denmark wishes its staff to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position. SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, is subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position(s).

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.
