People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

title: Care Worker
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Job Title: Care Worker Department: Support & Care Salary Scale: €34,350 per annum (rising to €44,000 with service) Responsible To: Team Leader Contract Type: Permanent Location: Ballinode, Co. Sligo Hours of Work: 39 hours per week (Covering a 24 hour, 7 days per week Rotational Shift Roster) ​ About Trinity You are joining Trinity Support & Care Services, an innovative organisation, providing quality assured, safe, and person-centred residential care and outreach support services to children and adults with intellectual disabilities. Key purpose of the job: ​ As a Social Care Worker, you will provide holistic Supports with day-to-day living, for individuals with a learning disability, autism or associated mental health needs. You will deliver person-centred and empowering provisions of support, to meet the individual needs of our service users. ​ Main responsibilities ​ The following duties are typical for this role. The post holder may not perform all of the listed duties and/or may be required to perform additional or different duties from those set forth below to address business needs, changing business practices and/or to meet the needs/changing needs of the Service User. ​ Service User ​ Provide assistance to Service Users in all aspects of personal care. Ensure the Human Rights of each Service User is exercised with the utmost degree of integrity and respect. Ensure a safe environment is maintained at all times for both Service Users, work colleagues and visitors to the unit/house. Ensure each Service User is encouraged to live in accordance with their own wishes and preferences, and their individuality promoted as far as possible, through new opportunities, promotion of skills and innate abilities. Ensure that each Service User receives the correct and relevant information to allow for informed decision making on their part at all levels. Ensure each Service User is supported in the least restrictive of ways and positive risk taking is a given element to their decision-making abilities. Support must also be in accordance with a low arousal and non-aversive manner. Personal outcomes are achieved in keeping with each Service User, with clear goals, steps for achieving such and timeframes. Ensure that supports are prioritised, and key commitments kept accordingly. To work in line with evidence-based practices. To ensure that each person is supported to live life to their fullest potential and remain (or become) socially valued members of their communities. Ensure that you work in a positive manner and professionally contribute to your staff team and wider organisation. If Interested in role, please email your CV to hr@trinityscs.ie. Head Office: Republic of Ireland (ROI) Digi Hub, M-Tek Centre | Armagh Road | Monaghan | | Co. Monaghan | H18 K03 ​

description:

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

title: Move Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Bond Business Support Ltd t/a Nat Ross Ltd is seeking an experienced Move Manager to join our team in Co. Cork. The successful candidate will manage the operational and logistical coordination of domestic and international relocations from initial booking through to final delivery. This includes planning moves, coordinating shipments and resources, preparing transport documentation, liaising with carriers and international agents, and monitoring schedules and costs. Key Responsibilities • Manage domestic and international relocation files from initial booking to completion. • Assess move requirements and prepare detailed move plans, schedules and operational instructions. • Coordinate collections, deliveries, packing, loading, shipping, storage and unpacking services. • Schedule moving crews, vehicles, equipment and specialist services as required. • Liaise with customers, international agents, carriers, crews, suppliers and warehouse staff. • Prepare quotations, confirm bookings and ensure services align with agreed requirements. • Prepare, review and amend air waybills (AWBs) and other international shipping documentation. • Use airline, carrier and agent portals to manage bookings and shipment information. • Coordinate customs and destination documentation where required. • Maintain accurate job records, inventories, shipment details, weights and volumes. • Monitor shipment schedules, resolve delays and communicate updates to relevant parties. • Review supplier and agent invoices and resolve discrepancies. • Monitor costs against quotations and maintain file profitability. • Prepare completed files for invoicing and ensure all costs are accurately recorded. • Ensure moves comply with relevant safety, insurance and operational requirements. • Resolve operational issues and post-move queries promptly while maintaining company service standards. Skills & Qualifications • Relevant experience in move management, relocation coordination, freight forwarding or international shipping. • Experience preparing or amending air waybills and international shipping documentation. • Experience using airline, carrier or freight-forwarding portals. • Experience reviewing shipment costs, supplier invoices and file profitability. • Experience using Moveware or a similar move-management system is desirable. • Knowledge of IATA requirements and customs procedures is an advantage. • Strong organisational, numerical and communication skills. • Strong planning and problem-solving abilities with excellent attention to detail. • Ability to coordinate resources and manage multiple relocation files and deadlines. • Proficiency in Microsoft Office. • Proficiency in additional languages would be an advantage. Employment Details Company: Bond Business Support Ltd t/a Nat Ross Ltd Location: Co. Cork Hours: 39 hours per week Salary: €37,000 per year Employment type: Full-time, permanent Work location: In person Benefits: • On-site parking • Company pension

description:

     You will be responsible for programming, setting, proving out, and optimizing Swiss-type CNC machines used in the manufacture of precision machined components. The key requirements of this role are developing robust machining processes, improving productivity, troubleshooting manufacturing issues, and maintaining consistent quality while working to tight tolerances across a range of metals and polymers. Competencies Technical qualification or equivalent experience in Precision Swiss Machining, Manufacturing, or related discipline highly desirable. Strong communication and teamwork abilities. Key Duties / Responsibilities Develop, test, and optimise CNC programs for Swiss-type CNC machines to produce precision machined components. Perform machine setups, prove-outs, and process validation for new and existing products. Interpret technical drawings and specifications to generate accurate and efficient machining processes. Select appropriate cutting tools, speeds, feeds, and machining strategies for a variety of metals and polymers. Support production by troubleshooting machining, tooling, and process-related issues. Continuously review and improve machining strategies to reduce cycle times, improve surface finish, and optimise tool life. Monitor process performance and implement improvements to increase productivity and process stability. Collaborate with Engineering, Production, and Quality teams to ensure manufacturability, quality, and on-time delivery. Maintain accurate documentation of programs, setup sheets, tooling requirements, and process improvements. Support operator training and provide technical guidance where required. Ensure compliance with ISO 13485 and other applicable quality standards.

Sligo Hours of Work: 39 hours per week (Covering a 24 hour, 7 days per week Rotational Shift Roster) ​ About Trinity You are joining Trinity Support & Care Services, an innovative organisation, providing quality assured, safe, and person-centred residential care and outreach support services to children and adults with intellectual disabilities. Key purpose of the job: ​ As a Social Care Worker, you will provide holistic Supports with day-to-day living, for individuals with a learning disability, autism or associated mental health needs. Ensure that supports are prioritised, and key commitments kept accordingly. To work in line with evidence-based practices. To ensure that each person is supported to live life to their fullest potential and remain (or become) socially valued members of their communities. description:

Job Title: Sheet Metal Worker Reports to: Structures Crew Leader Location: Atlantic Aviation Group, Shannon Airport, Shannon, Co Clare Apply: Email your up-to-date CV together with any supporting qualifications to careers@atlanticaviation.ie Atlantic Aviation Group With over 55 years of experience, Shannon based Atlantic Aviation Group (AAG) is one of Europe's leading independent aviation solution providers. The company has a strong reputation of providing customers with a complete range of solutions including; aircraft maintenance modifications, technical, engineering and design services, logistics and material solutions and international training and consultancy. This reputation is built on a proud history and tradition of superior craftsmanship, technical expertise and continuous training, which is supported by our flexible, open and partnership-based customer relationships. The company provides a range of aviation solutions including; Part 145 Aircraft Maintenance, CAMO & Technical Services, Part 21 Design Services and the EASA Part 147 Atlantic Aviation Institute which provides aviation training to airlines, MRO’s and companies around the world. Aircraft Sheet Metal Worker required to join the Structures Team in AAG. In this role you will be required to join the existing team in a busy Production environment. You will be expected to perform all types of repairs, assessments and modifications to Aircraft Structures and components. General Responsibility Accountable for the Safe, On-Time delivery of all Structural repairs. Repair, rework, install and fabricate the complex aircraft structural assemblies, both internal and external. Remove and disassemble defective parts of the aircraft Adhere to company procedures, maintaining Safety and Quality standards at all times, reporting any discrepancies to respective Manager/Team Leader, generating SMS reports as necessary Carry out all repairs and tasks using the relevant approved Repair Manuals, Drawings/Technical Instructions as provided by the OEM Maintain a safe, organized and clean work environment according to in house 5S principles, including proper usage of tooling Ensures relevant repair documentation is completed accurately and in a timely manner Working collaboratively with your Crew Leader, inspector and the Production team. Integration of our values and pillars as a constant way of operating including compliance with the organisational policies and procedures detailed in the Atlantic Aviation Group MOE and Supporting manuals. Candidate Requirements Candidates must have a minimum of 4 years’ experience in Aircraft Structures repair/modification. Heavy maintenance experience is an advantage but not essential. Must be proficient in the use of Aircraft manuals, Boeing Engine Atlantic Aviation Group is an equal opportunities employer. The people of Atlantic Aviation Group are the foundation of its success, and we believe that employing a diverse workforce is key to this success.

title: Deputy Operations Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Hawk's Well Theatre is an inspiring, welcoming and ambitious place to work. This is an exciting period of growth. Alongside our main 340-seat theatre in Sligo, we operate the Art Deco Cinema & Theatre in Ballymote. Keeping two busy venues running safely, smoothly and to a consistently high standard is central to everything we do. Behind every performance is an operation that has to work: a welcoming front of house, a well-run bar, clear procedures, and a team that keeps audiences safe and looked after from the moment they arrive. The role offers variety, responsibility and the chance to help deliver memorable experiences for audiences, artists and visitors across a busy and growing organisation. Working closely with the Operations Manager, the Deputy Operations Manager will help deliver the day-to-day operation of both venues. A central part of the role is taking primary operational responsibility for the bar, alongside direct supervision of the front of house and bar teams. We are looking for a practical, positive and hands-on operational leader. Day-to-Day Operations Support the daily operation of both venues, ensuring activity runs smoothly, safely and to a high standard. Act as Duty Manager as required, including evenings and weekends. Support venue readiness for performances, events, workshops, hires and public activity. Respond calmly and practically to operational issues, resolving them where possible and escalating when appropriate. Provide operational continuity and appropriate decision-making cover in the absence of the Operations Manager. Primary Delivery of Bar Operations. Take primary responsibility for the day-to-day operational delivery of bar services across the organisation. Ensure bar operations are safe, compliant, welcoming and efficiently staffed for each event. Maintain high service standards and ensure compliance with licensing requirements and responsible service of alcohol. Manage ordering, stock control, stocktakes, storage and replenishment of alcoholic and non-alcoholic products. Oversee tills, EPOS process cash procedures and accurate operational records. Monitor costs, reduce waste, support profitability and maintain effective supplier relationships. Prepare bar staffing requirements, shift briefings and post-event reporting Essential Experience & Skills Experience in a front-line operational, supervisory or Duty Manager role Experience managing or supervising bar or hospitality operations, including stock control and service delivery. Experience supervising, supporting and motivating staff teams. Strong understanding of customer-facing environments and excellent standards of customer care. Good working knowledge of health and safety. Sound organisational skills, accurate record-keeping and confidence using tills or EPOS systems. Flexible availability, including evenings and weekends. A full driving licence is required for the role.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

title: responsabile di deposito
description: Per Cliente leader nel suo settore di riferimento, siamo alla ricerca di un* RESPONSABILE LOGISTICA. La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione, dovrà: Coordinare un gruppo di circa 10 persone fornendo supporto e supervisione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Collaborare con altri dipartimenti, come Produzione e Pianificazione, per coordinare la consegna dei materiali ai reparti di produzione e di assemblaggio. Gestire e supervisionare tutte le operazioni logistiche, garantendo l'efficienza e l'accuratezza delle attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e trasferimento dei materiali. Assicurare il corretto ricevimento dei materiali in entrata, effettuando controlli di corrispondenza merce e quantità, garantendo l'integrità delle merci durante il processo di immagazzinamento. Ottimizzare i flussi di trasferimento dei materiali tra i due siti produttivi, definendo le opportune regole di gestione che possano correttamente bilanciare le esigenze di disponibilità dei materiali nelle aree produttive con la frequenza dei navettaggi. Supervisionare la gestione degli inventari, eseguendo controlli regolari per garantire l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere eventuali discrepanze o errori. Utilizzare software avanzati per la gestione del magazzino, come i magazzini verticali, al fine di migliorare l'efficienza e l'automazione delle operazioni. Raccogliere e analizzare in modo strutturato con l'ausilio delle metodologie e degli strumenti più avanzati i dati relativi ai flussi fisici nelle diverse aree aziendali (accettazione, stoccaggio, reparti e bordo linee) al fine di proporre azioni di ottimizzazione volte all'eliminazione di eventuali attività a non valore aggiunto e alla riduzione di eventuali sprechi. Mappare e analizzare i flussi informativi a livello di sistema gestionale (ERP) e sistemi dipartimentali (WMS/magazzini automatici) con l'obiettivo di individuare possibili miglioramenti che rendano più completi e veloci i trasferimenti delle informazioni. Monitorare e garantire il rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza e sulle pratiche di lavoro corrette nel magazzino. Gestire la manutenzione delle attrezzature e degli impianti del magazzino, compresi magazzini verticali e muletti. Coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, garantendo che le attrezzature siano in buone condizioni e che siano effettuate eventuali riparazioni o sostituzioni necessarie. REQUISITI Esperienza pregressa nella gestione di magazzini in realtà strutturate (meglio se operanti su commessa), preferibilmente caratterizzate dalla presenza di sistemi automatizzati (come magazzini verticali) e dall'utilizzo di software dipartimentali (tipo WMS - Warehouse Management Systems). Ottima capacità organizzativa per pianificare le attività logistiche e coordinare le risorse che a lui rispondono. Conoscenza delle best practice nella gestione del magazzino, inclusi processi di stoccaggio e movimentazione dei materiali. Leadership comprovata, con esperienza nella gestione di un team e nella delega di compiti. Capacità di analisi e problem-solving per identificare inefficienze, implementare soluzioni e migliorare i processi operativi. Familiarità con gli strumenti informatici utilizzati per l'analisi dei dati e capacità di elaborazione di report. Ottime competenze comunicative e capacità di collaborare con altri dipartimenti per garantire una gestione integrata delle operazioni. Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza e la salute sul lavoro relative alle attività di magazzino. RAL: 40-55K Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. #LI-GS2

Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati nelle loro prime esperienze lavorative, quindi a trasformare il proprio potenziale in percorsi professionali appaganti ed al passo con le tecnologie di mercato. Amministrare servizi di rete quali Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, File Server e sistemi di autenticazione. Gestire e monitorare gli ambienti di virtualizzazione Garantire l'esecuzione e il controllo delle procedure di backup e disaster recovery. Monitorare disponibilità, performance e sicurezza dei sistemi informatici Predisporre e aggiornare la documentazione tecnica relativa ai sistemi gestiti. Segnalare e proporre interventi migliorativi finalizzati all'incremento dell'affidabilità, sicurezza e continuità operativa dei servizi IT. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

description:

Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.

title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

description:

Gesucht wird für einen gehobenen 2-Personen-Privathaushalt in einem stilvollen kleinen Familienschloss in Liechtenstein eine erfahrene und engagierte **Hausdame / Gouvernante (m/w/d).** Die private Residenz umfasst rund 15 Zimmer sowie ein parkähnliches Grundstück. Sie arbeiten in einem gepflegten, repräsentativen Umfeld gemeinsam mit weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses und übernehmen eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit hoher Eigenständigkeit.

Ihre Aufgaben

- Verantwortungsvolle Führung und Organisation des gehobenen Privathaushalts
- Sicherstellung einer tadellosen Sauberkeit, Ordnung und gepflegten Atmosphäre im gesamten Haus
- Reinigung und Pflege hochwertiger Oberflächen, Materialien und Einrichtungen
- Fachgerechte Wäschepflege, einschließlich Waschen, Bügeln, Falten und Versorgen anspruchsvoller Textilien
- Sicherer und sorgfältiger Umgang mit hochwertigen Stoffen, Antiquitäten, Kunstgegenständen und wertvollem Inventar
- Vorbereitung und Zubereitung kleiner Mahlzeiten, insbesondere des Frühstücks
- Aufmerksame Betreuung der Hausherren sowie professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Gästen

- Koordination und Abstimmung mit den weiteren Mitarbeitenden des Hauses
- Konsequente Einhaltung und Kontrolle der geltenden Hygiene- und Qualitätsstandards

Ihr Profil

- Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Hausdame, Gouvernante oder in einer vergleichbaren Position in einem gehobenen Privathaushalt
- Fundierte Vorkenntnisse aus der 4- oder 5-Sterne-Hotellerie
- Ausgeprägte Gastgeberqualität, Serviceorientierung und ein sicheres, kultiviertes Auftreten

- Selbstständige, strukturierte und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
- Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Diskretion und Loyalität
- Flexibilität und Freude an der Arbeit in einem privaten, exklusiven Umfeld
- Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
- Gepflegte Erscheinung und ausgezeichnete Umgangsformen
- Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Arbeitszeiten am Wochenende
- Ausgezeichneter Leumund

Geboten wird

- Eine verantwortungsvolle und langfristig ausgerichtete Position in einem außergewöhnlichen privaten Umfeld
- Ein wertschätzendes Arbeitsklima in einem professionell geführten Haushalt
- Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren erfahrenen Mitarbeitenden in Haus und Garten
- Eine vielseitige, anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch
- Ein überdurchschnittliches Gehalt, welches sich an Erfahrung und Qualifikation orientiert

Bei der Wohnungssuche ist die Familie gerne behilflich, es handelt sich hier um eine Vollzeit-Anstellung. Gebeten wird um vollständige Bewerbungsunterlagen mit Lebenslauf, Referenzen und Angaben zu Ihrer Verfügbarkeit. Die Position ist nach Absprache zu besetzen und wird ausnehmend gut vergütet.

title: Vairuotojas - kurjeris su B kategorija
description:
Pasikrauti siuntas į mikroautobusą ir pristatyti jas pagal nustatytą maršrutą. 90% siuntų yra nuo dokumentų voko iki 5 kg pakuotės. Maksimalus vieneto kiekis - 25kg. Per dieną nuvažiuojamas atstumas apie 70 km. Per dieną padarysite apie 15 000 žingsnių -puiki kasdieninė apmokama fizinė veikla. Surinkti užsakymus iš klientų. Mandagiai ir profesionaliai bendrauti su klientais. Užtikrinti darbo kokybės rodiklių laikymąsi. Ko tikimės iš savo komandos nario? B kategorijos vairuotojo pažymėjimo ir saugaus vairavimo įgūdžių. Atsakingo požiūrio į darbą, punktualumo ir komunikabilumo. Panašaus darbo patirties – privalumas, bet ne būtinybė (visko išmokysime!). Grįžote po karinės tarnybos - puiku.
Jei dirbote Wolt ar Bolt pristatymo platformose, Jūsų patirtis yra puiki. Jums bus apmokėtas PSD, VSD, turėsite apmokamas atostogas. Nebijosite pajamų deklaracijos, nes mokesčiai yra sumokami už Jus.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Senior Solutions Architect, Benelux Solutions Architecture (m/f)
description:
Description:

Senior Solutions Architect, Benelux Solutions Architecture
Job ID: 10529083 | Amazon Web Services EMEA Sarl

Description

As a Solutions Architect at AWS, you'll build technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey.
You'll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, help them design and build some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient cloud architectures and solutions. You'll understand the customer's needs and give prescriptive guidance on how to create business value with AWS technology. You'll lead activities such as architecture reviews, white-boarding sessions, demos and technical workshops. You'll collaborate with other teams such as account management, professional services, support, product teams and the AWS partner ecosystem.
In this role you will get to practice your creativity, linking technology to tangible solutions and educating AWS customers about the art of the possible. You will have the opportunity to define and create best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
If you can educate AWS customers about the art of the possible, while challenging the impossible, come build the future with us.
This role is within the Benelux organization and you would be working with Enterprise customers.
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
Mentorship & Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic Qualifications

• Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).
• Experience in design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures
• Experience driving technical discussions, architecture design sessions & solution reviews
• Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English
• Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in manufacturing, process, or industrial engineering
• Experience migrating or transforming legacy customer solutions to the cloud
• Experience with AWS technologies
• Cloud Technology Certification (such as Solutions Architecture, Cloud Security Professional or Cloud DevOps Engineering)

title: Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A (m/f)
description:
Description:

Senior Financial Analyst, EU Operations FP&A
Job ID: 10528196 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

The right financial and business decisions have made Amazon what it is today. As a Senior Financial Analyst, you'll help us optimize our finances so that we can enhance our customer experience even more and navigate the fast-changing business environment. This role is an opportunity to act as the key finance leader and get really involved with shaping our business. You'll influence others and use insights to show senior stakeholders ways that we can move forward with our business ambitions.

Key job responsibilities

• Build financial models to drive business decisions and make judgement calls on challenges using your understanding of Amazon's cost structure
• Lead projects by overseeing timelines, priorities, auditing quality and resolving issues
• Generate insights from financial data, identify opportunities for greater efficiency, and communicate findings with the leadership team to drive business actions
• Own the financial reporting, create scalable processes and monitor teams for accuracy
• Onboard, develop and mentor team members in areas of financial reporting for accuracy, create best practice materials and promote knowledge sharing

A day in the life

Your typical day involves consolidating weekly or monthly financials for Cost-to-Serve initiatives, connecting with initiative owners to gather updates and validate data accuracy. You'll prepare insightful analyses for Management Business Reviews (MBRs) and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), focusing on trends and performance metrics. A significant portion of your time is dedicated to leading Quadrant reporting for Cost-to-Serve, requiring close partnership with Operations teams to ensure alignment and accurate representation of financial impacts.

About the team

Our team uniquely bridges Operations Finance and Stores organizations, owning Cost-to-Serve strategies and cost allocations that span multiple business units. We are the only team within Operations Finance that creates this valuable connection between these two critical organizations.
Our mission centers on providing financial clarity, driving cost efficiency, and enabling data-driven decision making across the business. We take pride in our ability to influence strategic decisions through robust financial analysis and cross-functional partnerships. By joining our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a significant impact while gaining exposure to multiple aspects of the business.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or above
• Experience in a finance role leading a project or program and partnering with multiple stakeholders within a business
• Experience working with Excel, reporting tools, and large-scale data mining tools, such as Power BI, Python, SQL, or Tableau
• Experience in financial modeling

Preferred Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Mathematics, or Economics
• Experience troubleshooting problems and offering solutions to streamline complex challenges
• Experience working in a large team or fast-paced corporate environment
• Experience making strategic business decisions and managing internal relationships

Analyser les besoins métiers et techniques des clients, définir les trajectoires de transformation et élaborer les architectures et services cibles adaptées aux contraintes d'exploitation, de sécurité, de souveraineté et de time-to-market. Diriger ou encadrer l'intégration des composants techniques nécessaires aux solutions retenues : réseau, sécurité, IAM, observabilité, sauvegarde, CI/CD, registry, plateformes Kubernetes, services de données et composants d'automatisation.
