title: Vil du være med og forme fremtidens helse- og omsorgstjenester i Åsnes ?
description:
Åsnes Helsehus har nå to ledige stillinger for autorisert sykepleier/vernepleier i 95%, med arbeid på dag og kveld.

Nå har du muligheten til å bli med på laget og være med og forme en helt ny organisering av tjenestene!

Åsnes Helsehus startet opp 01.09.26. Tidligere Åsnes sykehjem, hjemmesykepleie, praktisk bistand og Fleitar'n bofellesskap, er samlet i en ny og samhandlende enhet.

Vi er i gang med en spennende utvikling hvor målet er å skape bærekraftige, helhetlige og trygge tjenester for pasienter og pårørende - både i dag og i årene som kommer.

Den nye organiseringen skal legge til rette for bedre samhandling og sømløse overganger mellom hjemmet og institusjon, samtidig som som vi ønsker å bruke kompetansen vår på best mulig måte.

Rett kompetanse - på rett sted - til riktig tid.

Som sykepleier/vernepleier hos oss blir du en viktig del av dette arbeidet. Du får mulighet til å bidra med din fagkompetanse, utvikle deg videre og være med på å finne gode løsninger i en tjeneste som er i utvikling.


Ved interne søkere kan det bli ledig andre stillinger og stillingsstørrelser.

Dersom du ikke ønsker 95% stilling, ber vi deg skrive ønsket stillingsstørrelse i søknaden

Er du sykepleier/vernepleier - eller blir du ferdig utdannet våren 2027 - og har lyst til å være med på å utvikle fremtidens helse - og omsorgstjenester i Åsnes kommune ?

Da håper vi å høre fra deg!

Rett kompetanse - på rett sted - til riktig tid.


Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgavene vil variere ut fra tjenestens behov og din kompetanse, men vil blant annet innebære:

  • Utøve sykepleie/vernepleie i tråd med gjeldende lovverk, faglige retningslinjer og kommunens rutiner,
  • Kartlegge, vurdere, planlegge, gjennomføre og evaluere tiltak.
  • Medikamenthåndtering og oppfølging av medisinske behov.
  • Dokumentasjon og bruk av digitale fagsystemer.
  • Tverrfagligsamarbeid og samhandling på tvers av tjenestene.
  • Veiledning og samarbeid med pasienter, pårørende og kollegaer.
  • Bidra til fagutvikling, kvalitetsarbeid og kontinuerlig forbedring av tjenestene.
  • Bidra til gode overganger mellom hjemmet og institusjon.
Kvalifikasjoner

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er autorisert sykepleier eller vernepleier.
  • Er sykepleier - eller vernepleierstudent og fullfører utdanningen våren 2027.
  • Har gode norskferdigheter, både skriftlig og muntlig, minimum tilsvarende B2.
  • Har gode datakunnskaper og er komfortabel med å bruke digitale verktøy.
  • Bør ha førerkort

Relevant erfaring fra kommunehelsetjenesten, institusjon, hjemmesykepleier eller andre helse. og omsorgstjenester er en fordel, men vi oppfordrer også nyutdannede til å søke.

Personlige egenskaper

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er faglig engasjert og opptatt av kvalitet i tjenestene
  • Møter pasienter og pårørende med respekt, trygghet og omsorg.
  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og bidrar positivt i arbeidsmiljøet
  • Er fleksibel og løsningsorientert
  • Trives med endring og utvikling.
  • Kan arbeide selvstendig , samtidig som du ser verdien av godt teamarbeid
  • Ønsker å dele kunnskap og bidra til at vi utvikler oss sammen.

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Vi tilbyr
  • En spennende mulighet til å bli en del av nye Åsnes Helsehus.
  • Mulighet til å være med å påvirke og utvikle tjenestene videre
  • Et arbeidsmiljø med fokus på samarbeid, faglighet og utvikling
  • Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsoppgaver.
  • Mulighet for faglig utvikling og kompetansebygging.
  • En arbeidsplass hvor vi ønsker å spille hverandre gode.
  • Arbeid på dag/kveld i 95% stilling
  • Lønn etter tariff.

Åsnes og Solør er Innlandets grønne lunge. Vakre kulturlandskap og mektige skogsområder preger landskapet. title: Vil du bidra til å lede luftfartsprosjekter i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag?
employer: KONGSBERG AVIATION MAINTENANCE SERVICES AS AVD RYGGE
description:
Kongsberg Aviation Maintenance Services (KAMS) søker en erfaren Project Manager til vårt team på Rygge. På Rygge eier og drifter KAMS to hypermoderne vedlikeholdsdepoter til Norges femte generasjons jagerfly F-35 og KAMS har planer og ambisjoner for videre vekst. Ønsker du å bidra til å videre utvikle selskapet til å forbli en ledende leverandør av vedlikeholdstjenester i forsvarssektoren, er du hjertelig velkommen til oss.

Som Project Manager får du en sentral rolle i gjennomføringen av vedlikeholds-, reparasjons- og oppgraderingsprosjekter innen militær luftfart. Du vil ha ansvar og er driver for prosjektets leveranser, økonomi, fremdrift og kvalitet, og være en viktig kontaktperson både internt og overfor kunder og samarbeidspartnere.

Vi ser etter deg som trives med ansvar, evner å skape struktur i komplekse prosjekter og motiveres av å levere resultater gjennom tverrfaglige team.

Om rollen
Som Project Manager har du det operative ansvaret for prosjektene fra kontraktoverlevering til avsluttet leveranse. Du sikrer at prosjektene gjennomføres i henhold til avtalte krav, budsjetter og tidsplaner.
Rollen kombinerer prosjektledelse, økonomistyring, kontraktsoppfølging og kundehåndtering i et miljø med høye krav til kvalitet, sikkerhet og etterlevelse.

Hovedoppgaver og ansvar

  • Gjennomføre prosjekter innen vedlikehold, reparasjon og oppgradering av luftfartsmateriell
  • Sikre leveranser i henhold til kvalitet, kostnad, fremdrift og kontraktskrav
  • Utarbeide og følge opp prosjektplaner, budsjett og ressursbehov
  • Identifisere og håndtere risikoer og muligheter gjennom hele prosjektets livssyklus
  • Følge opp kontrakter, endringshåndtering og underleverandører
  • Sikre etterlevelse av krav knyttet til kvalitet, HMS og relevante luftfartsregelverk
  • Bygge og videreutvikle gode kunderelasjoner
  • Rapportere prosjektstatus, økonomi og fremdrift til ledelse og kunde
  • Bidra med prosjektfaglig støtte i tilbuds- og anbudsprosesser

Vi ser etter deg som har

  • Høyere teknisk utdanning på bachelor- eller masternivå
  • Erfaring med prosjektledelse fra teknologi- og ingeniørbedrifter
  • Erfaring med budsjettansvar, økonomioppfølging og kommersiell prosjektstyring
  • Erfaring med samarbeid i tverrfaglige team
  • Evne til å arbeide selvstendig og strukturert
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne på norsk og engelsk

Det er en fordel dersom du også har:

  • Erfaring fra luftfart, forsvarssektoren eller annen regulert industri
  • Kjennskap til MRO-virksomhet (Maintenance, Repair & Overhaul)
  • Kunnskap om luftdyktighetskrav og relevante myndighetsregelverk


Personlige egenskaper
For å lykkes i rollen tror vi at du:

  • Er en tydelig og trygg leder
  • Har høy gjennomføringsevne og tar eierskap til leveransene dine
  • Evner å bygge gode relasjoner internt og eksternt
  • Er analytisk, strukturert og løsningsorientert
  • Kommuniserer godt med ulike fagmiljøer og interessenter
  • Har høy integritet og sterk ansvarsfølelse

Sikkerhetsklarering
Stillingen krever gyldig sikkerhetsklarering eller at du oppfyller kravene for sikkerhetsklarering til nivå Secret/NATO Secret.

Hvorfor velge KAMS?
Kongsberg Aviation Maintenance Services (KAMS) er en ledende leverandør av vedlikehold, reparasjon og overhaling (MRO) innen militær luftfart. Med røtter tilbake til norsk luftfartshistorie og en sentral rolle i forsvarssektoren bidrar vi til å sikre operativ tilgjengelighet og flysikkerhet for våre kunder.

Som et selskap i KONGSBERG kombinerer vi spesialisert luftfartskompetanse og sterke fagmiljøer med mulighetene som ligger i et internasjonalt teknologikonsern. Vi leverer tjenester på tvers av flyplattformer, motorer og komponenter, og er kjent for høy kvalitet, pålitelighet og et kompromissløst fokus på sikkerhet.

Vi tilbyr

  • Muligheten til å bidra til et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
  • Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling
  • Et inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med høy kompetanse og sterk lagånd
  • Fleksibilitet og fokus på balanse mellom jobb og fritid
  • Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger, bonusordning og mulighet for deltakelse i KONGSBERGs aksjeprogram


Klar for å søke?
Registrer din søknad og CV via vårt rekrutteringssystem.

Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Siden starten på militær luftfart i Norge har Kongsberg Aviation Maintenance Services (KAMS) og forgjengerne spilt en betydelig rolle i norsk luftfartsindustri. Vi har endret og tilpasset oss utviklingen innen luftfart, men vår dedikasjon til innovasjon og pålitelighet har aldri endret seg. I dag er vi mer ambisiøse enn noen gang og vi er utrolig stolte over å være en leverandør i verdensklasse av vedlikehold, reparasjon og overhaling på tvers av flere flyvende plattformer, inkludert fly og helikoptre, men også motorer og komponenter. KAMS er også en av leverandørene av nye deler til et av de største luftfartsselskapene i verden.

title: Fleksibel BPA-stilling i Gamle Asker: Kreativ 12 åring søker assistent
description:
Hvem skal du jobbe med ? 

Vår kreative og morsomme 12-åring skal nå få et eget team av assistenter rundt seg! Vi søker trygge og tålmodige voksne som vil bidra til økt selvstendighet, mening og livsmestring i hverdagen hennes.

Jenta vår bruker mye tid på forskjellige kunst- og hobbyprosjekter, i tillegg til å bake og kose med de to kattene våre. Det blir også en del chilling og spilling – enten alene eller sammen med gode venner.

I det siste har hun hatt overskudd til å dra ut oftere på kafé og lignende, men i noen perioder har hun mest behov for å være hjemme. Du må derfor være en person som tar dagen som den kommer, være fleksibel og ikke bli for fort rastløs.

Hvem er du ?

Det er et pluss om du har helsefaglig bakgrunn, eller erfaring med å jobbe med barn og unge, men det er ikke et krav. Kanskje har du en hobby, eller studerer noe hun vil lære mer om - som for eksempel koreansk, biologi, vitenskap, kunst eller design? Det viktigste er ikke hva du har gjort før, men at du har et varmt hjerte og lyst til å lære.

Du må også være en som klarer å beholde roen, hvis hun er stresset og utilpass.

Vi oppfordrer studenter, nyutdannede, ufaglærte og deg med hull i CV'en til å søke. Det vi vektlegger aller mest ved ansettelse, er god kjemi og personlig egnethet.

Hvordan vil din arbeidshverdag se ut ?

Arbeidsoppgaver og aktiviteter vil variere etter jentas interesse, dagsform og årstid. Hovedarenaen for jobben er i hjemmet til familien, men kan også innebære turer og aktiviteter ute.

Typiske arbeidsoppgaver kan være:

  • Legge til rette for ro eller aktiviteter, og vurdere hva som trengs i øyeblikket.

Hvorfor skal du velge Humana?

Hos Humana er du mer enn bare en ansatt. Vi er opptatt av din trivsel, og du får god oppfølging fra dag én. Du blir en del av et støttende assistent-team, og vi tilbyr både veiledning og kurs for at du skal lykkes i jobben.

title: Chef - Frich's Hotel Alvdal, Norway
employer: FRICHS HOTEL OG SPISERI ALVDAL AS
description:
Frich’s Hotel Alvdal is looking for a qualified and motivated Chef to join our kitchen team. This is a permanent, full-time position with a planned start in October 2026.

 

We are looking for an experienced chef who is comfortable working independently, taking responsibility and being an active part of the kitchen team. You should be reliable, motivated and able to maintain good quality and structure throughout your shift.

 

The kitchen covers different concepts and services throughout the day, from morning until evening. You will therefore work with varied tasks and need to be flexible and comfortable taking responsibility across different parts of the operation.

 

Good teamwork is essential. You will work closely with the other members of the kitchen and hotel team, and we are looking for someone who communicates well, contributes positively to the working environment and is willing to support colleagues when needed.

 

To be considered for the position, you must be a qualified chef with a relevant trade certificate or equivalent professional culinary qualification. Previous professional kitchen experience is required, and you should be able to work independently without needing constant supervision.

 

We offer a permanent, full-time position and the opportunity to become part of an established hotel operation in Alvdal. Accommodation can be arranged for NOK 3,500 per month during the initial period. This gives you an easy start when relocating to Alvdal, but you will be expected to find your own long-term accommodation after settling in the area.

 

Start date: October 2026
Location: Alvdal, Norway
Accommodation: Available initially for NOK 3,500 per month

 

If you are a qualified chef looking for a stable, permanent position in Norway and enjoy taking responsibility while working as part of a team, we would be happy to hear from you.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Frich’s Hotel & Restaurant Alvdal is located in the heart of Østerdalen, halfway between Oslo and Trondheim. The hotel has 38 rooms and welcomes both business travellers, tourists and guests exploring the region. The restaurant is an important part of the operation and serves guests throughout the day, including breakfast, lunch, dinner and à la carte. The menu combines classic Norwegian dishes with modern flavours, alongside daily specials, sandwiches, baked goods and menus for groups and events. This gives the kitchen team a varied working day and experience across several different food concepts.

title: PhD Candidate in Sea Ice Monitoring
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

Are you interested in the present and future sea ice state in the Arctic Ocean?

There are several means of observing ice conditions in ice-choked waters. For some applications, daily or weekly information on sea ice is sufficient, whereas for maritime operations a much higher temporal resolution is needed — especially with regard to ice drift, so that onboard and remote operations are provided with accurate information for decision-making. Complex operations in the marginal ice zone with Autonomous Underwater Vehicles and Unmanned Surface Vehicles also rely on ice drift and general ice situational awareness at a high spatio-temporal resolution.

The project shall explore the use of marine radar onboard ice-going vessels as decision input for Arctic marine operations. The idea is to use the radar to identify the ice drift surrounding the vessel, and also to explore its potential for identifying concentration, floe size, geometry, and possibly stage of development. The plan is to build models so that radar measurements alone can be used to populate, as far as possible, the Stage of Development, Concentration, and Form fields — thereby obtaining a "live" Egg Code for decision-making onboard the vessel at all times. 

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. The position is likely to involve fieldwork in Arctic conditions.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

This PhD position is affiliated with Arctic Ocean 2050, a ten-year Norwegian research initiative bringing together 18 institutions to explore how the Arctic Ocean will change over the coming decade. The program's vision is a sustainably and collaboratively managed Arctic Ocean, approached as one interconnected system spanning from the seafloor to the atmosphere, addressing the local, regional and global consequences of climate change in the region.

The initiative is organized around six research themes: global drivers and feedbacks, the changing Arctic Ocean, abrupt changes and adaptation, human activity in the Blue Arctic, modelling and observing, and Arctic pathways for policy-relevant solutions. This position contributes to the modelling and observing theme, developing radar-based methods for ice drift and situational awareness that feed directly into the program's broader research effort.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the Maritime and Smart infrastructure research groups 
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
  • Other career-promoting work 

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.


Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in Cybernetics, Electrical Engineering, Remote Sensing, (Geo)Physics, Applied Mathematics, Marine Technology, Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's  Doctoral Programme in Engineering

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Familiar with use of real-world data
  • Experience with fieldwork
  • Experience with signal and image processing

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • WWork independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity 
  • Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

This PhD project will investigate cyber risk management in maritime operational systems. Maritime operations increasingly depend on interconnected operational technology, automation, remote access and data-driven services. While these developments create new opportunities, they also introduce cyber risks that may affect safety, security and operational continuity. Managing these risks requires an understanding of the interaction between human operators, technology and operational conditions.

The project must maintain a clear connection to maritime operational technology and operational environments. Candidates may approach the research area from a technological, human factors, organizational, risk management or maritime operational perspective, and are not expected to have prior expertise in all the areas covered by the project. The candidate is expected to collaborate with maritime stakeholders and apply the research to relevant industrial or operational cases.

The candidate will join a research environment working at the intersection of cybersecurity, maritime operations and human–technology interaction. title: PhD Candidate in Stakeholder Engagement - the Social Dimension of Nuclear-Powered Merchant Shipping
employer: NTNU FAKULTET FOR INFORMASJONS- TEKNOLOGI OG ELEKTRONIKK
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0About the position

We invite applications for a PhD position focusing on stakeholder engagement in the context of nuclear-powered merchant shipping.

As the maritime sector seeks pathways towards deep decarbonisation, nuclear propulsion has re-emerged as a potential technology capable of delivering large-scale emission reductions while meeting the growing energy demands of international shipping. While research has focused on the technical, economic, regulatory, and safety aspects of nuclear propulsion, considerably less attention has been given to the social dimensions that may ultimately determine its successful implementation.

As part of WP6 on Stakeholder Engagement, included in the Centre for Research-based Innovation on Nuclear-powered merchant shipping (SFI SAINT), this PhD project will address this knowledge gap by investigating how local communities and other key stakeholders perceive the health risks associated with nuclear propulsion, and how information sharing and stakeholder dialogue affect trust, stress levels, and public concern.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.


About the project

SAINT (Sustainable, Applied and Industrialized Nuclear Technology) is a research project investigating the use of nuclear propulsion for commercial and specialist maritime vessels and aims at launching 2-3 demonstration ships in the early 2030s. SAINT addresses the technical, safety, and operational challenges that must be resolved before such systems can be responsibly deployed. PhD candidates will be among the people shaping this emergent field. In the intersection of nuclear and maritime engineering qualified engineers and researchers are scarce globally, but also competence in stakeholder engagement is important for the successful implementation of nuclear-powered shipping. Stakeholder engagement is essential to build the public trust, safety confidence, and regulatory approval required for adopting nuclear power in commercial vessels. Candidates who complete a PhD within the SAINT project will be well positioned for careers in nuclear safety, maritime regulation, advanced vessel design, and the emerging commercial nuclear sector.


Duties of the position
  • Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Academic publications and popular science dissemination
  • Participate in the research group SFI SAINT
  • Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions

Required selection criteria
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree covering topics such as stakeholder engagement, risk perception, psychosocial health, behavioural responses, risk management, risk- and crisis communication, or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
  • Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position. 
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. 
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (link), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • Fluency in Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is required, as well as good oral and written presentation skills in English
  • We do not accept applications of citizens from countries on the OFAC and EAR lists and countries under US arms embargoes as well as heavy restricted/ITAR proscribed countries. 

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.


Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience with statistical analyses is preferred. 
  • While not essential, familiarity with nuclear technology, radiation protection or maritime operations would be beneficial for understanding the context.

Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
  • Present and discuss your research with other professionals
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.


We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.


Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.


Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Medicine and Health Sciences within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.


About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Any publications or other relevant research work
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees


If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.

NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).


General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

IIf you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate professor Marianne Synnes Emblemsvåg, Phone: +47 47268858, Marianne.synnes@ntnu.no.  If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact Unni Sletten (HR), e-mail: us@ntnu.no.

Application deadline: 05.10.2026

title: Software Tech Lead – Drilling Monitoring
description:
4Subsea is a leading provider of technology and services for subsea oil and gas, renewables, and marine operations. We are a vision- and value-driven company. We believe success comes from working together as a team, with our values as the foundation for everything we do.

Our multidisciplinary team combines deep domain expertise with sensor data and advanced algorithms to deliver critical decision support to energy providers. We help operators optimise offshore drilling and minimise downtime in hydrocarbon production. In 4Subsea, the Drilling Monitoring department both develops and delivers subsea structural integrity monitoring services for the offshore drilling market. We use data from sensors installed both subsea and topside on drilling rigs to ensure safe and efficient drilling operations.

We are now looking for a highly skilled and passionate Software Technical Lead to strengthen our Drilling Monitoring team.

Responsibilities

As Software Technical Lead in the Drilling Monitoring department, you will play a key role in shaping and delivering next generation digital services under the Drilling Monitoring umbrella. More specifically, the role includes:

  • Own the architecture. You define the technical direction for cloud-based and distributed (edge) systems such as the Riser Monitoring System (RMS) and the Subsea Well Integrity Monitoring (SWIM™).

  • Write code. This is a hands-on role. You're in the codebase every day alongside the team.

  • Partner with product. Work directly with product owners to shape what gets built and why.

  • Raise the bar. Share knowledge, review code, define standards, and help newer engineers grow, through pairing and example, not management.

What we look for

  • Strong Python skills in a web and backend context

  • Experience with Angular or other modern frontend frameworks

  • Experience with Linux-based systems

  • Background in engineering-facing software is a plus — oil & gas, energy, or similar industrial domain

Why should you apply?

  • Work on genuinely critical systems; the kind where quality and reliability matter

  • Small team, real ownership; no bureaucracy between you and impact

  • A tech stack that keeps evolving: cloud, edge, real-time data, modern web

  • Tight-knit team with deep domain expertise and a collaborative culture

  • Competitive insurance and pension packages

Work location

  • Asker, Norway

What we offer

  • A role with genuine impact

  • The opportunity to work with cutting‑edge technology in a highly skilled, cross‑disciplinary team

  • A collaborative, supportive environment where curiosity is encouraged and valued

  • A fun, “geek‑friendly” culture with engineers, data scientists, and domain specialists

  • Career development and progression opportunities within a global organisation

  • Competitive compensation and benefits

  • Weekly sports activities and monthly social events

  • On‑site gym

Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway! We’re more than willing to adapt the role for the right candidate.

We can offer an interesting role in a technology-leading company with global outreach. The company was established in 2007, and we have as a team been able to maintain an entrepreneurial and agile mindset over the years.

NORSK

Software – Technical Lead

4Subsea er en ledende leverandør av teknologi og tjenester for subsea olje og gass, fornybar energi og marine operasjoner.Vi er en visjons- og verdidrevet bedrift. Vi tror suksess kommer av samarbeid, med våre verdier som fundament for alt vi gjør.

Vårt tverrfaglige team kombinerer dyp domenekompetanse med sensordata og avanserte algoritmer for å levere kritisk beslutningsstøtte til energileverandører. Vi hjelper operatører med å optimalisere offshore boring og minimere nedetid i hydrokarbonproduksjon.

I 4Subsea utvikler og leverer avdelingen Drilling Monitoring tjenester for overvåking av strukturell integritet på subsea brønnhoder. Vi bruker data fra sensorer installert på boreplattformer for å sikre trygge og effektive boreoperasjoner.

Vi leter nå etter en dyktig og engasjert Software Technical Lead for å styrke Drilling Monitoring avdelingen.

Ansvarsområder

Som Software Technical Lead i Drilling Monitoring avdelingen vil du ha en nøkkelrolle i å forme og levere neste generasjon digitale tjenester under Drilling Monitoring paraplyen. Mer spesifikt innebærer rollen:

  • Eie arkitekturen. Du vil definere teknisk retning for både sky-baserte og edge-baserte systemer slik som Riser Monitoring System (RMS) og Subsea Wellhead Integrity Monitoring (SWIM™)

  • Skrive kode. Du vil være direkte involvert i utvikling av kodebasen vår på daglig basis.

  • Samarbeide med produkteiere. Forme veikart for produktene våre og være med å bestemme hva som skal bygges

  • Utvikle deg selv og andre. Dele kunnskap, kvalitetssikre andres arbeid, definere standarder for hvordan vi jobber og være en faglig mentor for nye utviklere og ingeniører

Hva vi ser etter

  • Lang erfaring med Python både i web og backend kontekst

  • Erfaring med Angular eller lignende moderne frontend-rammeverk

  • Erfaring med Linux baserte systemer

  • Erfaring med software- og produkt-utvikling innen ingeniørfag er et pluss, helst innen olje og gass eller energisektoren generelt

Hvorfor bør du søke?

  • Du vil få jobbe med kritiske systemer hvor kvalitet og pålitelighet er helt avgjørende

  • Du vil jobbe i et lite team hvor det er kort vei fra ide til handling

  • Du vil jobbe med en teknologi platform som er i stadig utvikling og som består av både sky, edge, sanntidsdata og moderne web utvikling

  • Drilling Monitoring er et sammensveiset team med sterk domene kompetanse

  • Vi tilbyr konkurransedyktige forsikrings- og pensjonspakker

Arbeidssted

  • Asker, Norge

Hva vi tilbyr

  • En rolle med reell påvirkning

  • Muligheten til å jobbe med banebrytende teknologi i et høyt kompetent, tverrfaglig team

  • Et samarbeidsorientert og støttende miljø hvor nysgjerrighet oppmuntres og verdsettes

  • En morsom og “geek-vennlig” kultur med ingeniører, data scientists og fagspesialister

  • Muligheter for karriereutvikling og progresjon i en global organisasjon

  • Konkurransedyktig kompensasjon og gode betingelser

  • Ukentlige sportsaktiviteter og månedlige sosiale arrangementer

  • Treningsrom på arbeidsplassen

Oppfyller du ikke alle kravene? Søk likevel! Vi er mer enn villige til å tilpasse rollen for den rette kandidaten.

Vi kan tilby en spennende rolle i et teknologiledende selskap med global rekkevidde. Selskapet ble etablert i 2007, og vi har som team klart å bevare en entreprenør- og smidig tankegang gjennom årene.

title: Head Baker Wanted – Lead the Rise at Flåm Bakery
description:
Are you a skilled and passionate baker who loves crafting high-quality baked goods – and ready to take charge of production in a bakery known for its high standards? Would you like to build strong teams and play a key role in further developing our bakeries in Flåm and Lærdal? Then we’d love to hear from you!

Flåm Artisan bakery is looking for an experienced baker to lead the production team.

About us:

Flåm Bakeri opened in 2016 and has been a fantastic success ever since. Last summer, we moved into brand-new, spacious premises on the waterfront in the heart of Flåm. Our second location, Laksen Bakeri & Kafé in Lærdal, has seen similar growth. Together, we offer a wide range of products, including artisan breads, traditional Norwegian sweet buns, and classic international pastries – as well as local juices, sandwiches, pizza, and barista coffee. We also do daily deliveries of bread and pastry products to Myrkdalen Resort, our hotels in Flåm/Aurland and Sognaporten.

As Head of Bakery Production, you will play a central role in ensuring our bakeries deliver top-quality baked goods every day. You’ll be a key partner to Gro, manager at 3 of our venues, and help drive the development of our production processes, product range, and team culture.

Key responsibilities:

  • Plan and organize the daily production of baked goods across our locations to ensure freshness and quality at all times
  • Actively participate in production while maintaining high standards and efficient workflows
  • Collaborate with the leadership team to develop and adapt our product offerings in line with customer preferences and market trends
  • Follow established food safety and hygiene procedures (IK-mat) and ensure compliance with all health and safety regulations
  • Support administrative tasks such as shift planning and recruitment
  • Foster a positive and inclusive team culture with a focus on motivation, collaboration, and well-being
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of production routines and product development

    Qualifications:

  • Certificate of apprenticeship (fagbrev) as a baker or equivalent experience in food production
  • Several years of experience from an artisan bakery, with solid knowledge of production techniques and quality control
  • Experience with cake baking is a plus
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to lead and inspire a team
  • Driver’s license (Class B)
  • Good English communication skills, both written and verbal
  • Knowledge of Norwegian or another Scandinavian language is an advantage, but not a requirement

We offer:

An exciting position in an ambitious and dynamic company committed to people and community. You’ll join a proud and passionate team within one of Norway’s leading tourism companies, where we encourage both personal and professional growth. At Norway’s Best, we value diversity and inclusion – it’s reflected in our culture. Our employees are encouraged to ask questions, be themselves, and are seen and respected for who they are.

Some of our employee benefits:

  • Competitive employment terms
  • Pension and insurance schemes through Nordea Liv and Gjensidige
  • Discounts and offers on products and activities from Norway’s Best

Location: Flåm Bakeri
Start date: Autumn 2026, or by agreement


Norway’s best Group AS (NBG) er eit leiande norsk reiselivskonsern, med nokre av Norges mest spektakulære natur- og kulturbaserte reiseopplevingar i vår portefølje. Konsernet har sitt hovudkontor i Flåm, og kontorstader i Myrkdalen, på Voss, i Bergen og Narvik. Vi har ein nasjonal ambisjon og er ein konsolidator i norsk reiseliv. NBG er i front på heilskapleg reisemålsutvikling, og har i dag ei verksemd bygd på våre heilårssatsingar i Flåm, Myrkdalen og Narvik. I over 25 år har vi posisjonert Flåm, med Flåmsbana og Nærøyfjorden, til å bli eit av Norges mest populære reisemål. I pudderparadiset Myrkdalen, med Myrkdalen Fjellandsby, har vi den største skidestinasjonen på Vestlandet. I nord eig vi Narvikfjellet i Narvik og verdens nordlegaste dyrepark Polar Park i Bardu. Selskapet har i tillegg aktivitet i Aurland, Lærdal, Geiranger og Oslo. Selskapet har ein stor kommersiell avdeling som marknadsfører og selger våre eigne og andre aktørar sine attraktive produkt til gjester over heile verda. NBG har ein omsetning på vel 850 MNOK, meir enn 500 heilårs- og deltidsansatte og 2 millionar gjester årleg. Utover vår reisemålssatsing eig NBG-konsernet også det innovative selskapet The Fjords, som tilbyr unike nullutslepps reiseopplevingar på norske fjordar, og 50% av den spektakulære Flåmsbana. NBG er ikkje berre eit reiselivskonsern, vi er også ein samfunnsbyggar som ønsker å skape positive ringverknader og attraktive lokalsamfunn der vi har vår verksemd. Vi ønsker å vere i front på bærekraftig reiselivsutvikling og bidra til ei ansvarleg og framtidsretta reiselivsnæring. Vi gjer vårt yttarste for å redusere vår miljøpåvirkning og støtte opp rundt lokal verdiskaping. Våre ansatte er kjernen i verksemda og vi ønsker å skape eit inkluderande, mangfaldig og likestilt miljø med attraktive arbeidsplassar.

title: Driftsmedarbeider – 100% fast stilling
description:
Vest Bilutleie søker en pålitelig og selvstendig driftsmedarbeider til fast 100% stilling i Herøysund. Stillingen passer for deg som liker en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag, trives med ansvar og har øye for detaljer. Erfaring fra bilbransjen er ikke nødvendig – vi gir opplæring.

Hva vi ser etter

Vi ser først og fremst etter en person vi kan stole på og gi ansvar.

Du bør være:

  • Pålitelig og punktlig

  • Selvstendig

  • Detaljorientert

  • Serviceinnstilt

  • Løsningsorientert

  • Komfortabel med kundekontakt

  • Glad i en aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag

  • Villig til å lære og utvikle deg

  • En person som tar initiativ når noe må gjøres

Hos oss får du mye tillit, og vi ønsker derfor en medarbeider som ser hva som må gjøres og følger opp oppgavene sine uten at alt må detaljstyres.

Krav:

  • Førerkort klasse B

  • Må kunne kommunisere på norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig

  • Må være komfortabel med å kjøre forskjellige typer biler

Fordel, men ikke krav:

  • Førerkort klasse BE

  • Erfaring fra kundeservice

  • Erfaring med bilpleie eller klargjøring

  • Erfaring fra logistikk, transport eller lignende

Tidligere erfaring fra bilbransjen er ikke nødvendig. For oss er innstilling og arbeidsmåte viktigere enn hvilken bransje du kommer fra.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Klargjøring av biler mellom utleier

  • Innvendig og utvendig vask

  • Polering og annen bilpleie

  • Kontroll av biler før og etter utleie

  • Registrering og oppfølging av skader og andre avvik

  • Kontroll av kilometerstand, drivstoff/lading og generell tilstand

  • Kundebehandling på telefon, digitalt og ved behov fysisk

  • Oppfølging av bookinger og den daglige driften

  • Utlevering og mottak av biler

  • Hjulskift i sesong

  • Henting, levering og transport av biler

  • Andre praktiske oppgaver knyttet til driften

Noen dager vil hovedfokuset være klargjøring og bilpleie, mens andre dager vil innebære mer kundebehandling og drift.

Arbeidstiden er i hovedsak mandag til fredag, hovedsakelig på dagtid, med enkelte faste dager hvor arbeidstiden legges til ettermiddag.

Vi tilbyr

  • Fast 100 % stilling

  • Lønn etter avtale / konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • 4 % pensjon

  • Forsikringsordninger

  • Arbeidsklær

  • Ansattrabatt på bilutleie

  • Full opplæring

  • Variert og aktiv arbeidshverdag

  • Stor grad av tillit og selvstendighet

  • Muligheter for utvikling og mer ansvar

  • Kort vei fra idé til beslutning

Vest Bilutleie er i rask utvikling, og du kommer inn på et tidspunkt hvor det fortsatt er mulig å påvirke hvordan vi jobber, hvilke rutiner vi bygger og hvordan rollen utvikler seg videre.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Vest Bilutleie er et lokalt bilutleieselskap i rask vekst, med base i Herøysund og flere utleielokasjoner på Vestlandet.

Vi tilbyr utleie av personbiler, varebiler og større kjøretøy til både privat- og bedriftskunder. Selskapet har vokst betydelig på kort tid, og vi jobber kontinuerlig med å utvikle både bilparken, tjenestene våre og måten vi driver på.

Teknologi er en viktig del av satsingen vår. Vi utvikler egne digitale løsninger internt for blant annet booking, drift og kundeoppfølging.

Hos oss er det korte beslutningsveier, stor grad av tillit og gode muligheter til å påvirke hvordan selskapet utvikler seg.

title: Byggsakkyndig--Kartlegger
description:
Stavanger kommune har distriktets største og mest varierte eiendomsportefølje. Som inneholder alt fra skoler, barnehager, museumsbygg, administrasjonsbygg, bydelshus, kulturbygg til eldre vernede bolighus i gamle Stavanger. En slik variert portefølje, krever kompetanse på en rekke områder. 
Seksjon for Forvaltningsprosjekter er organisatorisk plassert under Bymiljø og utbygging, henholdsvis avdeling Eiendom. Seksjonen bistår Formålsbygg og Boligbygg med prosjektgjennomføring, hvor overordnet mål er å gjennomføre og levere gode prosjekter innenfor de gitte økonomiske rammer, til avtalt tid og avtalt kvalitet.  

Arbeidet
med systematisk kartlegging av tilstanden på kommunens eiendomsportefølje er startet. Vi ønsker nå å styrke staben og søker engasjerte og dyktige bygningssakkyndige til å delta i videreføring av dette arbeidet. Bygningssakkyndige vil få et selvstendig ansvar for planlegging og gjennomføring av kartlegging og rapportering.  

Du er engasjert og har god erfaring fra bygge og eiendomsbransjen, innen tilstandsanalyser og teknisk kartlegging av eiendom. Du er oppdatert på relevante forskrifter og standarder. Digital kompetanse er absolutt ett pluss.


ArbeidsoppgaverTilstandskartlegging av kommunen eiendommer etter gjeldene standard NS 3424.   
Klimaskjerm, terrengforhold, trapper, med mer
Innvendige overflater og fastmontert utstyr

Utarbeide kostnadskalkyler som danner grunnlag for budsjett i vedlikeholdsplanen, samt som grunnlag for prosjekter (tidlig fase).  
Rådgivning mot forvaltning og prosjekt  
Kartlegging av brudd på forskriftskrav i henhold til bruk av bygget.  KvalifikasjonerDet er ønskelig med følgende kvalifikasjoner: 
 
Takstutdanning er en fordel
Relevant utdanning som bygg ingeniør, teknisk fagskole, mesterbrev, takstmann 
Dokumentert erfaring fra tilstandskartlegging

Strukturert og med gode planleggingsevner

Engelsk – beherske skriftlig og muntlig

Evne til systematisk oppgaveløsning og til å håndtere uforutsigbarhet

Kunne håndtere periodevis mange baller i luften  
Fleksibel med evne til å tilpasse seg nye arbeidsoppgaver  
Har god økonomiforståelse  
Har gode IT-kunnskaper og har interesse for bruk av IT-systemer  
God muntlig og skriftlig fremstillingsevne  Vi tilbyr
Allsidige og utfordrende arbeid i en spennende eiendoms portefølje.
Del av ett kompetent fag miljø hvor vi gjør hverandre gode, med ansvarsfulle oppgaver og stor grad av selvstendighet.
Et godt arbeidsmiljø og trivelige kolleger med solid erfaring
Gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger gjennom KLP
Lønn etter avtale ut fra kvalifikasjoner og erfaring 
Fleksibel arbeidstid
Gode utviklingsmuligheter og hjelp til tilrettelegging slik at du lykkes med dine karrierevalg og arbeidsprestasjoner.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Stavanger kommune er, med sine 11 000 ansatte, en av regionens største arbeidsgivere.

Vi mener inkludering og mangfold er en styrke. Vi er opptatt av at arbeidsstyrken i størst mulig grad skal gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte til å søke, uansett alder, kjønn, funksjonsevne, seksuell orientering, religion eller etnisk bakgrunn. 

Vi jobber for heltidskultur med mål  om å ansette i hele stillinger.

Som ansatt i Stavanger kommune får du utgjøre en forskjell for kommunen og innbyggerne og blir en del av en spennende storbyregion. 

Vi bygger fellesskap ved å være nære, åpne og nyskapende

Offentlig søkerliste: 
Stavanger kommune praktiserer prinsippet om meroffentlighet. Offentlig søkerliste vil normalt inneholde navn på samtlige søkere. Det må foreligge tungtveiende grunner for å få innvilget unntak, jamfør Offentleglova §25.

Politiattest:

title: PhD Research Fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics
description:
About the position

Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at the University of Oslo invites applications for a doctoral research fellow in Machine Learning and Statistics. We seek a motivated researcher, who values collaboration, inclusivity, and impact, and who would like to contribute to a supportive, interdisciplinary research environment with strong focus on mentoring and career development.

Starting date upon agreement, and no later than 31 January 2027.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.

Place of work is Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning at University of Oslo at Blindern, Oslo.

We welcome applicants with a strong background in machine learning and statistics, who are eager to contribute to cutting-edge methods for generating private and fair synthetic data with good utility. This project involves development of deep learning based synthetic data generators that obtain both good utility and protection of privacy, through tailored model approximation, as well as new measures of privacy and fairness to be used for assessing properties of synthetic generators, or in loss functions for training them. Further, the potentials and limitations of the developed approaches should be critically assessed regarding their implications for fairness, privacy, and utility. This project is at the intersection of machine learning, statistics and ethics.

This position is affiliated with the research group research group in Statistics and Data Science at the Department of Mathematics at University of Oslo, in close collaboration with the machine learning group at the Department of Informatics.


About Integreat

See the video for more information about Integreat.

Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 

Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). This position is in Oslo.

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

The focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, statistics, data science, mathematics, or related field
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Employment and admission to the PhD programme are conditional upon successful completion of the Master's degree and submission of official documentation confirming that the degree has been awarded. Applicants who are in the final stages of completing their Master's degree may still apply.

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience with deep learning models
  • Strong background in programming
  • A keen interest in considering and discussing ethical aspects of the research projects
  • Experience with interdisciplinary work

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

  • the average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • the Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. For more information see: Supplementary Regulations at the Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences to the Regulations for the Degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo - The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


Personal skills

We are looking for candidates who are curious, open-minded, and motivated to learn. You should enjoy working both independently and as part of a team, and be comfortable communicating your ideas clearly across disciplines. A collaborative spirit, a strong sense of responsibility, and a willingness to contribute to an inclusive and respectful research culture are essential.

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We need different perspectives in our work 

Integreat is committed to equity, diversity, inclusion, and belonging, guided by our INTEGREAT principles (Integrity, Non discrimination, Tact, Environment, Gratitude, Respect, Empathy, Accountability, Transparency). We embed these values in practice through inclusive hiring and structured evaluations, targeted mentoring and career development, and flexible work arrangements and accommodations to ensure everyone can thrive and contribute.

We particularly welcome applications from women and gender minorities who are underrepresented in STEM, as well as applicants with immigrant backgrounds, disabilities, non linear career paths, or career breaks. We will take career interruptions and diverse career trajectories into account during evaluation.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps, we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports.

More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here.


We offer
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK 550 800 – 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2% is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund
  • A unique research environment with multiple opportunities to develop research themes at the forefront of modern science
  • A friendly, inclusive, and collaborative international working environment that values diverse perspectives
  • Access to a strong network of top-level national and international collaborators
  • A reliable and generous pension agreement, along with strong public benefits
  • Comprehensive welfare schemes supporting both personal and professional well-being
  • Full access to public health services through membership in the National Insurance Scheme
  • A vibrant academic environment with an active and supportive research community
  • Structured career development programmes at the faculty level and an individual professional development plan throughout the postdoctoral period
  • Mentoring and support structures tailored to early-career researchers
  • Flexible working conditions, with understanding for different life situations and family responsibilities
  • Research mobility funds supporting short research stays and international collaboration
  • Family-friendly surroundings in Oslo and Tromsø, with rich opportunities for culture, nature, and outdoor activities
  • A clear institutional commitment to gender equality and diversity, with dedicated initiatives and networks for women in science

Integreat provides a researcher training programme, INTREF - the Integreat Young Researchers’ Forum - a fellow driven initiative offering scientific training, transferable skills workshops, mentorship, research visits, and career development support.


Application

Your application should include:

  • Cover letter – describe your motivation for pursuing a PhD at Integreat and in Norway, with particular emphasis on your research interests and academic achievements to date relevant for this position and the project
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Transcripts of records, copies of the original Bachelor’s and Master’s degree diploma (see below)
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • If relevant you may attach Master thesis or a draft of your thesis
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)
  • Documentation of English proficiency

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for the position". Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will invited for interviews.

Please note that we are unable to add documentation after the application deadline. As the deadline applies equally to all applicants, this policy ensures equal treatment throughout the recruitment process. If you experience difficulties uploading documents in Jobbnorge, please contact their customer service: Phone: +47 75 54 22 20 or Email: support@grade.com 

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees to secure the rights to all research results and related intellectual property.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to recruitment positions at UiO and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we cannot, you will hear from us.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest ranked educational and research institution, with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. With its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally recognised research communities, UiO is an important contributor to society.

Integreat – Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning - Integreat is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research council of Norway. Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway). Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world.

Integreat develops theories, methods, models and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. This will be done by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technologies, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

Focus of Integreat is to develop ground-breaking methods and theories, and by this solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science.

title: Camper Rental Office Responsible in Tromsø
description:
Office Responsible -- Join Our International Team in Norway

We are currently seeking a dedicated and motivated Office Responsible to join our dynamic team. This is a key role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys balancing structure, communication, and customer service. If you are detail-oriented, solution-driven, and looking to contribute to a growing company in the travel and outdoor industry, we would be pleased to hear from you.

About the Role

As the Office Responsible, you will be the first point of contact for many of our customers and a central figure in our day-to-day operations. You will handle booking and pre-booking coordination, assist with post-rental customer service, and manage internal support functions such as invoicing and payment allocations.

You will also provide critical backup to our rental agent team when needed, offering variety and ensuring smooth operations across departments. This position requires strong communication skills, a proactive mindset, and the ability to stay focused when working with complex information.

We are looking for a candidate who brings prior experience in coordination work or a similar office-based role, and is comfortable taking ownership of tasks in a structured and organized manner.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide customer support before, during, and after the booking process through email, phone, and online chat

  • Manage booking entries and updates within our booking system

  • Handle deposit processing, damage claims, and customer inquiries post-rental

  • Allocate ferry tickets, tolls, and parking fees to the correct bookings

  • Process invoices, purchase orders, and general company paperwork

  • Support internal accounting by preparing accurate Excel spreadsheets

  • Assist the rental team with operational tasks during busy periods

  • Suggest and support improvements to office workflows and processes


Who We Are Looking For

  • Proven experience in coordination, administration, or a similar office-based role

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English (Norwegian is not required)

  • Excellent focus and attention to detail, especially when working with data and allocations

  • Solid working knowledge of Excel and basic accounting practices

  • A problem-solver with a service-oriented mindset

  • Positive, proactive, and eager to take initiative

  • Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team

  • Open to supporting and collaborating with a diverse, international group


Our Work Environment

You will be joining a young and international team based in Norway, made up of outdoor-minded individuals from around the world. Our company language is English, and our work culture values openness, collaboration, and initiative. While the position is office-based, you will be part of a business that supports adventurous travel experiences across the country.

Why Join Us

This is an excellent opportunity to take on a varied and responsible role within a growing company. You will work closely with management and other departments, contribute directly to customer satisfaction and operational efficiency, and be encouraged to bring your ideas to the table.

We offer a supportive and flexible work environment, where professional development is valued, and where your role can evolve as the company grows.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Arctic Campers is Norway's largest camper van rental company, offering 200 camper vans across two locations: Oslo and Tromsø. With over 10 years of experience, we specialize in helping tourists explore and enjoy the stunning Norwegian nature. Our goal is to provide unforgettable adventures, giving you the freedom to discover Norway at your own pace.

title: Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss
description:
Rådgjevar bedriftsmarknad - pao Voss

Likar du å arbeida med folk, økonomi og ha gode kundemøte?
Er du typen som ser ei oppgåve som må gjerast, og berre gjer det?
Då vil me gjerne høyra frå deg.

Voss Sparebank er ein sjølvstendig lokal sparebank med 28 tilsette.

Me kjenner kundane våre, me kjenner kvarandre – og me likar å gjera lokalsamfunnet til ein betre plass å bu og leva.

No ser me etter ein ny kollega som skal vera rådgjevar for bedriftsmarknaden
på Voss og nærområdet vårt.

Hjå oss får du ikkje berre kontorpult, stol og PC i moderne lokale.
Du får høve til å bli kjend med verksemdene i lokalsamfunnet, forstå kva dei driv med og vera ein viktig sparringspartnar når dei skal investera, utvikla seg eller ta nye steg.

Ingen dagar er like. Nokre dagar sit du fordjupa i ein kredittsak. Andre dagar er du ute og møter ein kunde, diskuterer investeringar over ein kaffikopp eller finn ut korleis me kan hjelpe ei lokal bedrift vidare.

Om du trivst med ansvar, relasjonar, tykkjer om samfunnsoppdraget vårt og likar at arbeidsinnsatsen din vert opplevd som meiningsfull. Då er dette kanskje ei stilling for deg?

Arbeidsoppgåver
Som rådgjevar på bedriftsmarknaden får du ansvar for eiga kundeportefølje.
Du vil mellom anna:
  • Rådgje og selja banken sine produkt og tenester til eksisterande og nye bedriftskundar – kreditt, forsikring, leasing, pensjon og sparing/plassering
  • Følgja opp og utvikla gode kunderelasjonar
  • Vurdera kreditt, utarbeida og presentera kredittsaker
  • Vera ein aktiv sparringspartnar for kundane våre og forstå behova deira
  • Oppsøkja nye kundar og byggja nettverk i næringslivet
  • Samarbeida med kollegaer i heile banken for å finne gode og heilskaplege løysingar
Kvalifikasjonar
  • Du har høgare utdanning innan økonomi.
  • Du er tidleg i karrieren, eller er nyutdanna.
  • Det er òg fint om du har interesse for, eller erfaring frå finans, rekneskap
    eller revisjon.
  • Du har interesse for lokalt næringsliv.
  • Du er god til å skriva nynorsk eller villig til å læra det.
  • Det er eit pluss om du har autorisasjonar frå FinAut.
    Om du ikkje har det, må du på sikt vera motivert for å gjennomføra autorisasjon i kredittfaget.
Personlege eigenskapar
  • Du likar å snakka med folk og skapa tillit.
  • Du er nysgjerrig på bedrifter, menneske og økonomi.
  • Du kan analysere tal, men også forstå menneska bak tala.
  • Du ser kva som må gjerast og tek i eit tak når det trengst.
  • Du trivst med kundekontakt og nettverksbygging.
