title: QA and Test Lead
description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a QA and Test Lead, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You can create a quality strategy that teams understand, own and use when delivery pressure rises.

The partner is delivering a complex platform change across several systems and suppliers. You will lead test planning, coordinate evidence and make sure critical user journeys are verified from component level through business acceptance.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Define the overall test strategy and risk based scope.

    

Connect requirements and use cases with verifiable test coverage.

    

Coordinate environments, data, teams and external dependencies.

    

Lead defect triage and readiness reporting.

    

Guide automation priorities and non functional testing.

    

Communicate quality risk clearly to project and business leadership.

What you will bring

    

Extensive test leadership in complex technology programmes.

    

Strong requirements, integration and acceptance testing experience.

    

Ability to plan across several teams and release stages.

    

Evidence based reporting and defect management.

    

Understanding of test automation and modern delivery methods.

    

Professional English; Swedish may be required for public partners.

Experience that would add value

    

Procurement or implementation of a major business system.

    

Performance, security or resilience test coordination.

    

Experience in healthcare, government or another regulated domain.

A background that can succeed here

You may come from hands on testing, business analysis or programme quality management. The partner needs someone who can discuss detail with engineers and provide a concise risk view to decision makers.

What makes the opportunity interesting

This role gives you a central position in a consequential change programme. You will shape how quality is demonstrated and help the organisation make release decisions based on evidence rather than optimism.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

The recruitment conversation

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

title: IT Service Delivery Manager

The partner needs a service delivery leader for business critical workplace and infrastructure services. You will manage performance, suppliers and continual improvement while keeping the experience of employees and business teams visible.

Strong ITIL knowledge applied pragmatically.

    

Supplier, SLA and commercial management ability.

Clear reporting and stakeholder communication.

title: Creative Director
description:
Agency-Based | Outdoor, Lifestyle & Active IndustriesPosition Overview

We are seeking an experienced, strategic, and highly collaborative Creative Director to lead the creative vision and execution of campaigns, content, and brand experiences for clients across the outdoor, lifestyle, wellness, fitness, sport, travel, and active industries.

This agency-based role will work across multiple client accounts, translating business objectives, audience insights, and brand positioning into compelling creative strategies and culturally relevant content. The Creative Director will lead projects from initial concept through production, delivery, and rollout, ensuring that every asset is strategically grounded, visually distinctive, operationally sound, and aligned with each client’s brand standards.

The ideal candidate is both a visionary creative leader and a strong operator—someone who can inspire teams, present and defend ideas, build trusted client relationships, and confidently manage the details required to deliver high-quality work across multiple channels and timelines.

Creative Leadership and Vision

Lead the conceptual, strategic, and visual direction of seasonal campaigns, evergreen content programs, product launches, brand initiatives, and ongoing client communications.

Establish and maintain a distinctive, consistent, and relevant visual identity for each client.

Influence the look, feel, tone, and overall creative expression of brand assets across regional, national, and global markets.

Translate strategic insights, marketing objectives, audience needs, and business goals into clear creative strategies and engaging content platforms.

Develop creative approaches that inspire, move, and connect with end users while authentically expressing each brand’s purpose, values, and point of view.

Set creative standards and provide direction across photography, video, graphic design, digital artwork, motion design, typography, copy integration, and branded experiences.

Stay current on emerging trends in culture, design, digital marketing, social media, technology, production, and the outdoor, lifestyle, and active industries.

Identify opportunities to evolve and strengthen client brands while maintaining consistency with established brand guidelines.

Concept Development:

Generate original ideas in response to creative briefs, strategic assignments, campaign objectives, and client needs.

Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign platforms, content series, product stories, and integrated brand experiences.

Create and oversee concept boards, mood boards, visual references, style guides, treatments, sketches, mockups, storyboards, and presentation materials.

Clearly communicate creative concepts, strategic rationale, intended audience impact, and production approach to clients and internal stakeholders.

Present, sell, and defend creative ideas with confidence, clarity, and sound strategic reasoning.

Develop custom content ideas and creative approaches for retail, ecommerce, wholesale, merchandising, sales, social, editorial, digital, and experiential channels.

Ensure creative ideas are scalable and adaptable across formats, markets, platforms, and stages of the customer journey.

Lead creative projects from concept development through pre-production, production, post-production, final delivery, and rollout.

Plan, strategize, and execute lifestyle and product photography and videography shoots.

Drive and direct global and regional campaign photo and video shoots, ensuring that the creative vision is consistently realized on set and through post-production.

Develop creative treatments, shot lists, storyboards, casting direction, location recommendations, styling direction, production schedules, and visual references.

Collaborate closely with photographers, directors, videographers, producers, stylists, set designers, editors, animators, retouchers, developers, and other production specialists.

Provide creative direction during casting, location scouting, pre-production meetings, shoots, editing sessions, color grading, retouching, sound design, animation, and final delivery.

Balance creative ambition with budget, schedule, logistics, production realities, client needs, and usage requirements.

Review and approve work at all stages to ensure quality, consistency, accuracy, and alignment with the approved creative direction.

Experience leading both in-house and external creative, production, and freelance teams.

As necessary, must be proficient shooting still imagery to lead or supplement campaigns, provide BTS imagery or conceptual imagery.

Team Leadership and Collaboration

Lead and manage in-house, freelance, outsourced, and partner creative teams across multiple client accounts.

Direct photographers, videographers, production teams, stylists, designers, developers, editors, agencies, and other external specialists.

Build and facilitate a highly motivated, collaborative, inclusive, and accountable creative environment.

title: Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) - Remote (IT-Systemadministrator/in)
description:
Remote Senior Systems Administrator (80-100%, f::m::d) Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. At OnlineDoctor AG we are looking for a System engineer! Our tech stack: AI, Atlassian, Confluence, Support, JIRA, Microsoft 365, Security, Slack, Office 365. Requirements: - Proven hands-on experience administering Microsoft 365 at the tenant level (user lifecycle, groups, roles, licensing, security settings, integrations)

- Strong understanding of access control principles: authentication, authorization, SSO, and identity management
- Experience administering Atlassian products (Jira, Confluence) including workflow design and governance
- Demonstrated ability to establish scalable governance standards across a tooling ecosystem and improve operations independently
- Strong communication skills and the ability to partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Your responsibilities are: Microsoft 365 & Identity
- Serve as the tenant-level administrator for Microsoft 365, owning configuration, security settings, and feature management
- Manage the full user lifecycle: provisioning, role assignment, license management, and offboarding
- Design and enforce access control policies, including group structures, permissions, and role-based access

Tool Ownership

- Own the administration, configuration, and continuous improvement of all company tools including Slack, Atlassian Jira, Confluence, and others
- Support teams in configuring workflows and collaboration structures that fit how they work
- Manage vendor relationships, renewals, and license optimization to control costs

Automation & Operation

- Build and maintain secure integrations between internal tools to improve workflow consistency and reduce manual work
- Automate repetitive operational processes such as onboarding/offboarding, license provisioning, and access requests
- Maintain clear documentation for configurations, integrations and operational procedures
- Provide reliable support, monitor critical tools and lead incident responses for outages, access issues and integration failures. Category: System Developer / Engineer Location address: Waisenhaustrasse 15, Munich, Germany. Salary: 65000 - 75000 EUR per year. OnlineDoctor AG - More about us and the role:Join OnlineDoctor: Were Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine startup focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses cutting-edge technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to take pictures of their skin issues and receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

Were looking for a Systems Administrator to take full ownership of our internal tooling landscape and IT operations. This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who is self-directed, detail-oriented, and passionate about improving and professionalizing reliable, secure, and well-governed systems.

You will be the owner of our internal tool ecosystem — responsible for access control, security, integrations, cost management, and operational continuity across all platforms. You will establish clear governance and standards, improve how we provision and protect our tools, and ensure every employee has seamless, secure access to what they need.

What we offer:

- Flexibility: You decide if you want to work remote or if you prefer to visit one of our Offices (Hamburg, St. Gallen, Zürich). We offer you a flexible schedule and a working time model that suits you.
- Learning culture: We offer you a steep learning curve in your daily work and support you in your personal and professional development through regular retro and inspiration sessions as well as advanced training. We are open for ideas and impulses and help you with the implementation.
- Team events: Skiing in Switzerland, white water rafting in Vienna - we regularly get together with our entire team and thus increase our teamwork.
- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

Work Location & Relocation:
Due to current legal and regulatory reasons, we can only hire team members who live in Germany or Switzerland. If youre based elsewhere but excited to join OnlineDoctor, were happy to discuss and support your relocation to either country.

Ready to Join Us?
If weve convinced you, get in touch to apply for this position. We look forward to meeting you soon!  last updated 34 week of 2026

title: BPM & Automation Engineer (all genders), Lausanne (Industrietechnologe/-technologin - Datentechnik)
description: We bring together AI expertise, engineering excellence and in-depth industry knowledge - driven by people who want to make a difference together. This leads to future-proof solutions that genuinely make a difference in our customers' everyday lives. We achieve this through people who take responsibility, recognise opportunities and turn technological possibilities into tangible results. To this end, we create an environment characterised by mutual support: opportunities for professional development, open communities where knowledge is readily shared, peer groups and training programmes tailored to your needs. Trust, appreciation and successes celebrated together shape the way we work together and make personal development an integral part of our culture. WHAT YOU CAN MOVE Analyze business processes and identify opportunities for automation and optimization. Model business processes using BPMN 2.0 and, where relevant, DMN and CMMN. Design, configure and develop workflows on Flowable, Camunda or similar BPM platforms. Implement process logic, forms, business rules, service tasks and integrations. Integrate BPM solutions with existing applications and IT landscapes using REST APIs and other web services. Work with relational databases and SQL to support process-related data requirements. Collaborate closely with business stakeholders, subject-matter experts, architects and development teams. Translate business requirements into robust, maintainable and scalable technical solutions. Write readable, testable and maintainable code, following clean-code principles. Contribute to testing, deployment, documentation and the ongoing support of automation solutions. Participate in Agile delivery teams and contribute to continuous improvement. Stay up to date with developments in BPM, workflow automation, hyperautomation and related technologies. HOW YOU SUCCEED Good practical knowledge of BPMN 2.0; experience with DMN or CMMN is an advantage. Experience with process analysis, workflow modeling and the implementation of automated business processes. Solid understanding of RESTful web services and experience working with JSON and/or XML. Practical experience with SQL and relational databases. Experience with Git or another version-control system. Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective technical solutions. A degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Software Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent professional training and experience. Full professional proficiency in French and English An agile mindset, strong analytical skills and a structured way of working. Good communication and collaboration skills, with confidence when interacting with both technical and business stakeholders. Customer-oriented, proactive and motivated to learn and develop in a growing Business Automation team. Nice to have 2 years of professional experience in BPM, workflow automation, software engineering, business analysis or a comparable field. Experience developing with Java and Spring Boot. Experience with Flowable, Camunda, Appian, Appway, IBM Business Automation Workflow, UiPath or similar platforms. Familiarity with JavaScript and modern web technologies. Experience with Docker and CI/CD practices. Knowledge of Agile methods such as Scrum, Kanban or SAFe. Interest in hyperautomation, AI-supported process automation or agentic automation. Relevant certifications in Flowable, Camunda or another BPM platform.  OPPORTUNITY GIVER - WHAT MAKES ADESSO SPECIAL Our promise: You will feel at home with us! Collegial, collaborative and on an equal footing - we live exchange, team spirit and respectful interaction. We value diversity and different perspectives just as much as you as a person. This and much more stands for our very special sense of togetherness. There's even a word for it: adessi.  Learn and grow with us: we support your continuous development with over 400 training courses and our digital learning platform. Experience real team spirit: joint events (e.g. sport weekend and the annual eduCamp training trip), welcome days and company runs strengthen our team spirit and allow you to be part of the team from the very beginning. Commitment that is rewarded: Your commitment pays off - with bonuses for recommendations, lectures, thesis supervision and attractive benefits via our corporate benefits portal. Our culture and the way we work together are characterized by mutual appreciation, recognition and support. This unites us - even when working from home. Part-time work is possible by arrangement (80-100%). We have once again been voted one of the best employers in Switzerland! Our extensive training program and a transparent career level model for everyone ensure that your development with us never stands still. Because growing together and creating opportunities is programmed into our DNA. CONTACT You will like it here with us! Apply now directly online by clicking the blue button below. adesso Schweiz AG // Recruiting // T +41 58 520 97 03 // career@adesso.ch #LI-Hybrid

- Knowledge of SAP FI and SAP S/4HANA Finance is a plus
- Fluent German (C1) and good English skills
- Flexible and willing to travel (20% up to 40%)

description:
**Stellenantritt:** nach Vereinbarung **Arbeitsort:** Bern Die kantonale Terminologie ist sehr vielfältig; sie betrifft nicht nur das Recht, sondern auch alle anderen Bereiche, mit denen sich die Kantonsverwaltung befasst, wie beispielsweise Schulen, Strassenbau, Finanzen, das Gesundheitswesen oder auch die Landwirtschaft. Der ZTD arbeitet eng mit den Sprachdiensten zusammen und steht allen Organisationseinheiten zur Verfügung, die sprachliche Fragen haben. **Ihre Aufgaben**
* Thematische und punktuelle Arbeiten zur Erweiterung der kantonalen Terminologiedatenbank LINGUA-PC * Qualitätssicherung im Bereich der kantonalen Sprache und Verwaltung * Mitwirkung bei der Verwaltung und Weiterentwicklung von Sprachtechnologie-Tools
**Ihr Profil**
* Muttersprache: Deutsch oder Französisch; ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse der anderen Amtssprache; weitere Sprachen: von Vorteil * Masterabschluss in Terminologie oder Masterabschluss mit Schwerpunkt Terminologie oder Studium mit Schwerpunkt Terminologie * Nach Möglichkeit Erfahrung in den Bereichen Terminologie und Terminographie sowie Kenntnisse der gängigen Terminologie-Tools * Sinn fürs Detail, methodisches und präzises Arbeiten, intellektuelle Neugier, Flexibilität, Teamgeist
**Wir bieten Ihnen**
* Einen Einblick in eine spannende, abwechslungsreiche und anspruchsvolle Tätigkeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen Politik und Verwaltung. * Ein angenehmes und motivierendes Arbeitsklima in schönen Räumlichkeiten in der Berner Altstadt. * Der Kanton Bern fördert die Gleichstellung der Geschlechter und unterstützt die Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf. * Flexible Arbeitszeiten; Homeoffice möglich
**Kontakt** Fragen zur Bewerbung? Tanja Heinz-Schreyer Personalleiterin 031 633 75 07 tanja.heinz-schreyer@be.ch Fragen zur Stelle? Donatella Leiterin der Zentralen Sprachdienste 031 633 75 29 donatella.pulitano@be.ch **Über die Staatskanzlei** Das in der Staatskanzlei angesiedelte Amt für Zweisprachigkeit, Gesetzgebung und Ressourcen (AZGR) ist Kompetenzzentrum für sprachliche Dienstleistungen wie Übersetzung und Terminologie. Es ist für die begleitende Rechtsetzung verantwortlich, behandelt zudem Fragen zur Zweisprachigkeit und unterstützt die Juradelegation des Regierungsrates bei der Vorbereitung ihrer Geschäfte. Weiter führt es die Zentrale Beschaffungsstelle Büromaterial und Print und ist für die Aufgaben- und Ressourcenplanung innerhalb der Staatskanzlei sowie für den Rathausbetrieb zuständig. Die Staatskanzlei ist eine vielseitige Dienstleisterin an der Schnittstelle zwischen Politik, Verwaltung und Öffentlichkeit. Sie ist Stabsstelle des Regierungsrats und Verbindungsstelle zum Grossen Rat. Dabei plant, unterstützt und koordiniert sie die Tätigkeit dieser Behörden und erbringt zahlreiche Dienstleistungen für die Verwaltung und die Bevölkerung.

title: Solution Architect SAP PS & SD
description:
Are you passionate about designing innovative SAP solutions and shaping the next generation of business processes? Join our team and play a key role in shaping and implementing the end-to-end architecture for customer project processes across SAP PS \& SD, and surrounding systems. Combining architectural responsibility with hands-on development, you will collaborate with Product Owners, development teams, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable, integrated, and future-ready solutions for our global organization. **This is where you'll excel**
* You shape the SAP solution architecture for customer project management across SAP PS \& SD and related custom solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic business objectives and enterprise standards * You design and specify technical solutions, either implementing them hands-on or guiding their delivery from concept to completion * You partner with Product Owners, Product Managers, and agile teams to refine, deliver, and operate solutions across the entire product lifecycle * You ensure seamless integration between SAP PS \& SD, other SAP modules, and external systems to support efficient end-to-end business processes * You provide expert 3rd-level support, troubleshoot complex issues, and coordinate with stakeholders to ensure timely resolution of incidents and requests
**These are the skills you'll need**
* Degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field (e.g., HF, FH, university, or an internationally equivalent qualification) * 5+ years of professional experience, including 3+ years in SAP solution architecture, development, or a comparable technical SAP role; agile experience (Scrum, SAFe) is a plus * Deep expertise in SAP PS and/or SD is ideal. What matters most is a strong architectural mindset across SAP modules, so candidates with deep expertise in another area such as FI/CO who bring broad SAP knowledge and a track record of designing integrated solutions are equally encouraged to apply * Strong hands-on expertise in ABAP and ABAP OO development, including custom programs, enhancements, BAPIs, and BADIs; BTP, OData, and CDS experience is a plus * Proven ability to take ownership, proactively drive initiatives and solutions, solve complex problems, and collaborate effectively across technical and business teams, combined with fluent business-level English
**Attractive vacation entitlement** Enough time for relaxation and personal interests - we offer from 25 to 30 days of vacation per year depending on age. **Attractive mobility concept** We offer an OSTWIND ZVV / Z-Pass + half-fare travelcard for CHF 365 + CHF 400 public transport credit as well as an attractive first-class travelcard or free parking. **VIVA Restaurant** We offer our employees a daily fitness menu from 9, 00 CHF. **Employer-funded pension plan** The Bühler Pension Fund offers Bühler employees an independent pension fund that ensures reliable financial security in retirement: www.pk-buhler.ch **Health-Port** We are committed to preventive health care through laboratory analyses, massages, nutritional advice, physiotherapy, group courses and a company doctor. **Sports activities** We promote physical activity through self-organized circuit training and running groups as well as vouchers for Update and Activ Fitness. **Questions? We are happy to answer them!** Marcel Huber Senior Recruiting Specialist [Linkedin](https://www.linkedin.com/in/marcel-huber-23a298b8/) **Creating impact together at Bühler!** Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Als Arbeitsort überzeugt Grabs Sie mit einer starken Industrie- und Gewerbebase, günstigen Bodenpreisen und einer hohen Lebensqualität in unmittelbarer Nähe zum Bodensee und Liechtenstein.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Langzeitpflege

Die Langzeitpflege lebt von Beziehung: Sie begleiten Menschen über lange Zeit, kennen ihre Gewohnheiten und bauen echtes Vertrauen auf. Dabei begleiten Sie auch komplexe, chronische Verläufe – mit Ruhe und Kontinuität statt Hektik.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen in der Langzeitpflege rund um Grabs ist derzeit sehr hoch, da Altersheime und Betreuungseinrichtungen konstant unter Fachkräftemangel leiden. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen und können zwischen verschiedenen attraktiven Positionen im 80–100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, passgenauen Stellenvorschlägen und dem Netzwerk zu etablierten Arbeitgebern in der Region, was Ihnen einen reibungslosen Einstieg garantiert.

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Langzeitpflege in Grabs

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

### Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Wetzikon: das Wichtigste in Kürze

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutspital

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Wetzikon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Wetzikon liegt im Zürcher Oberland und besticht durch eine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung via Bahn und Autobahn. Die dynamische Stadt bietet Ihnen ein breites Spektrum an Arbeitsplätzen in Industrie, Handel und Dienstleistungen. Die attraktive Lage zwischen Zürich und dem Appenzellland, kombiniert mit guter Infrastruktur und hoher Lebensqualität, macht Wetzikon zu einem wertvollen Arbeitsort für Pendler und Ortsansässige.

### So sieht Ihr Alltag als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon aus

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Was Sie für diese Stelle mitbringen

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German

title: Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène  à 60%
description:
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Les Usines Métallurgiques de Vallorbe SA (UMV) sont reconnues au niveau international comme le partenaire préféré des professionnels les plus exigeants pour ses outils de précision. Disposant de grandes capacités d’innovation, la société, forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, commercialise ses produits dans plus de 80 pays via un réseau de distribution.  
Dans le cadre d’une création de poste suite au développement de nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un/e  
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Vos missions  
Il ou elle assure une présence terrain régulière et contribue à la mise en œuvre et au suivi opérationnel des mesures de santé, sécurité \& hygiène définies par le Responsable SSH. Il ou elle appuie les équipes de production, de maintenance et d’infrastructure dans l’application quotidienne des règles de sécurité.  
Cette fonction est distincte du rôle de spécialiste MSST reconnu selon l’Ordonnance sur les qualifications des spécialistes de la sécurité au travail, qui reste porté exclusivement par le Responsable SSH.  
Vos activités :  
Réaliser des tournées de sécurité régulières sur le terrain et contrôler l’application de la politique SSH et des points sécurité \& santé (feu, gaz, matériel de sécurité, matériel de secours, EPI),  
Participer à l’élaboration des documents opérationnels de sécurité, en appui du Responsable SSH,  
Travailler en collaboration avec le Responsable SSH à la réduction des risques du site,  
Gérer les équipements de protection individuelle (attribution, contrôle, renouvellement, traçabilité),  
Mettre à jour la documentation relative aux contrôles et aux mesures terrain,  
Remonter les points sécurité au Responsable SSH et participer à l’amélioration des statistiques incidents, presqu’accidents et accidents,  
Analyser les événements terrain, proposer des plans d’actions correctifs et en assurer le suivi,  
Participer aux projets et actions en lien avec le secteur SSH et les différents secteurs de production,  
Participer à l’organisation des exercices d’évacuation pour le personnel,  
Assurer un appui administratif au groupe des Samaritains, en soutien du Responsable SSH,  
Assurer un soutien opérationnel dans le suivi des accès (clés, logiciels de contrôle d’accès),  
Gérer les vêtements de travail, les vestiaires, l’infirmerie et le matériel d’urgence,  
Instruire les collaborateurs aux exigences SSH,  
Planifier et coordonner les formations terrain (quart d’heure sécurité, causeries, exercices pratiques),  
Communiquer au Responsable SSH le suivi des indicateurs et constats terrain,  
Collaborer avec les prestataires externes pour les aspects opérationnels et remonter les informations au Responsable SSH pour la prise de décision.

Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Nachtwache 40-60% für die Region Mettmenstetten gesucht
description:
- Eine etablierte Institution in der Region Mettmenstetten sucht Verstärkung: Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH, Schwerpunkt Nachtwache.

### Ihr Überblick zur Stelle als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH in Mettmenstetten

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Nachtwache

**Pensum:** 40–60 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Mettmenstetten

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Mettmenstetten liegt malerisch in der Zürcher Landschaft und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage im Raum Zürich. Die Region bietet Sie mit einer ausgezeichneten Verkehrsanbindung, besonders zur nahegelegenen Stadt Zürich, an. Als Arbeitsort zeichnet sich Mettmenstetten durch das harmonische Zusammenspiel von ländlicher Ruhe und urbaner Nähe aus, was es für berufstätige Menschen besonders attraktiv macht.

### Das erwartet Sie als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Nachtwache in Mettmenstetten

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihr Profil – darauf kommt es an

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Nachtwache

Diese Stelle ist als Nachtwache angelegt. In der Nacht tragen Sie besondere Verantwortung: Kontrollgänge, Überwachung und ruhiges Handeln im Ernstfall. Zudem machen Zuschläge und die ruhigeren Phasen dieses Modell für viele Fachpersonen attraktiv.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Nachtwache in Mettmenstetten verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Genau solche Stellen vermitteln wir am liebsten.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Mettmenstetten verzeichnet anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere für Nachtschichten mit Teilzeitpensen. Sie profitieren als erfahrene Fachkraft von ausgezeichneten Chancen bei Spitälern, Kliniken und Pflegeinstitutionen, die gezielt nach qualifiziertem Personal suchen. Der Fachkräftemangel in der Pflege bietet Ihnen Verhandlungsspielraum bei Löhnen und Arbeitsbedingungen. Mit yaPersonal als Partner erhalten Sie Zugang zu präqualifizierten Stellenangeboten und professionelle Unterstützung beim Bewerbungsprozess, was Ihnen einen schnellen und unkomplizierten Einstieg in eine neue Position ermöglicht.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Mettmenstetten

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – denn wir fördern Ihre Karriere aktiv
- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Nachtwache in Mettmenstetten

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Meist hören Sie schon innerhalb von 24 Stunden von uns, denn Ihre Zeit ist uns wichtig. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

title: Courtier Ventes Résidentielles (H/F)
description:
Vos missions :

En tant que courtier-ère spécialisé-e dans l'immobilier résidentiel, vous jouez un rôle clé dans le développement et la réussite des transactions immobilières sur le marché genevois.

À ce titre, vous serez amené-e à :
- Développer un portefeuille de biens résidentiels (appartements, villas et autres biens) grâce à une prospection active.
- Réaliser des estimations de biens et accompagner les propriétaires en leur apportant des conseils personnalisés adaptés à leur projet.
- Mettre en œuvre la commercialisation des biens : rédaction et diffusion des annonces, organisation des visites et valorisation des propriétés.
- Accompagner vendeurs et acquéreurs tout au long du processus de vente, de la première prise de contact jusqu'à la signature, en assurant un suivi rigoureux.
- Conduire les négociations avec professionnalisme afin de garantir la satisfaction des différentes parties.
- Assurer une veille permanente du marché immobilier genevois afin d'identifier les opportunités et les évolutions du secteur.

Profil recherché :
Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience confirmée d'au moins 10 ans dans le courtage immobilier, idéalement dans le secteur résidentiel. Vous possédez une excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois ainsi qu'un réseau professionnel développé.

Autonome, dynamique et orienté-e résultats, vous êtes reconnu-e pour votre sens commercial, votre capacité à instaurer une relation de confiance et votre qualité de service. Vous maîtrisez les techniques de négociation et savez accompagner vos clients avec professionnalisme tout au long de leur projet.

Compétences et prérequis :
- Expérience de 10 ans minimum en courtage immobilier résidentiel
- Excellente connaissance du marché immobilier genevois
- Réseau professionnel solide dans la région
- Français langue maternelle
- Anglais courant
- Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels
- Permis de conduire indispensable.

Déplacements :
Des déplacements réguliers sont à prévoir dans le cadre de cette fonction.

title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Automation & Operation

- Fair salary: An attractive salary is a matter of course for us.
- Additional benefits: Free choice of laptop, home office allowance, additional vacation day, etc.
- Our Values: Respect and tolerance are part of our DNA. We actively support diversity and inclusion, believing they are the keys to a successful and healthy company culture.

title: Natural Hazards Mission Lead
description:
ETH Zurich is establishing the ETH Swiss GeoLab, a new interdisciplinary unit of ETH Zürich I Space. ETH Space will soon become one of few strategic centres of ETH Zurich, and encompasses overall five units.

The GeoLab is focused on Earth observation and its applications. The GeoLab uses satellite, airborne, ground-based and in-situ observations. To these diverse data sets it applies AI-driven analysis methods and high-performance computing to develop solutions for specific societal and economic challenges.

Located at the D4 Business Village in Root, close to Lucerne, ETH Swiss GeoLab works at the interface of research, technology development and practical application. In its first phase, the GeoLab is focusing on few selected high-impact application areas where Earth observation, geodata and AI-based analytics can create tangible value for Switzerland. The Natural Hazards Mission focuses initially on mass movements, including landslides and rockfalls, with the aim of improving early detection, monitoring, preparedness and decision support for Swiss practitioners, authorities and infrastructure stakeholders. It builds on stakeholder engagement, solution scoping and community-building activities already underway within GeoLab, including contributions from senior domain experts and partners in the Swiss natural hazards community.

The ETH Swiss GeoLab is led by Prof. Dr Verena Griess and Prof. Dr Thomas Zurbuchen, with Dr Felix Seidel as Managing Director, responsible for the day-to-day operations of this exciting activity. The GeoLab will grow into a project-based hub of around 100 experts over the coming years and will collaborate closely with other ETH units, the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS), Swiss research institutions, public-sector stakeholders, natural hazard organisations, industry partners, start-ups and international stakeholders.

This position is offered as a fixed-term appointment for an initial period of two years, with the possibility of extension.

As Natural Hazards Mission Lead, you will lead the research and development portfolio, integration and delivery of GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Mission. Initially focused on landslides and rockfalls, and later expanding to other natural hazards, you will help define the mission vision, translate user needs into research and product requirements, and ensure that GeoLab activities create measurable value for Swiss practice and public decision-making. You will build on ongoing interchange with key stakeholders and solution-scoping activities already underway within GeoLab, and work closely with senior domain-relevant partners, technical teams and experts.

You will report to the Managing Director of ETH Swiss GeoLab and work closely with GeoLab’s Natural Hazards Community & Solutions Lead, other GeoLab mission teams, the Research Program Support team, and the Geo-Intelligence team and external partners. You will define priorities, milestones and decision points, lead mission delivery and will have the authority to prioritize, redirect, and pivot or pause activities within your research and development portfolio, the approved mission charter, budget and governance framework.

As part of your role, you will:

On behalf of the GeoLab leadership team, define an ambitious and coherent research and development portfolio for the Natural Hazards Mission, initially centred on landslides and rockfalls
Translate identified critical operational gaps into measurable outcomes that create value for practitioners, authorities and decision-makers
Engage with local, cantonal and federal authorities, infrastructure operators, practitioners, industry and expert communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Translate operational challenges into research, data, product and technical requirements
Establish measurable mission outcomes, roadmaps, assumptions and success criteria aligned with Swiss natural hazard needs and the overall GeoLab strategy; you will also track progress actively against these outcomes
Manage the delegated mission budget and define priorities, milestones, decision points and success criteria and track finances and successes in that framework, through regular reporting activities to GeoLab leadership and other stakeholders
Work with the Geo-Lab’s Intelligence team – the team deeply focused on AI and Earth  observation foundational models - and external performers to drive pilots, field validation, operational testing and integration into user workflows
Assess evidence and performance, and recommend continuation, redirection, scaling, pausing or termination of activities
Identify and mobilise strong ETH groups, research institutions, engineering and geology offices, remote-sensing companies, public agencies and implementation partners
Represent ETH Swiss GeoLab in Swiss natural hazard, scientific, policy and industry communities, in coordination with GeoLab leadership and existing Natural Hazards community activities
Communicate mission goals, progress, evidence and lessons learned to internal and external stakeholders
Guide and train students, researchers and external contributors where required and support the transfer of resulting capabilities into operational practice
In summary, you understand the needs of practitioners and decision-makers in the field of natural hazards and their relation to Earth observations from space and are motivated by the opportunity to translate research and technology into practical solutions with measurable impact.

Specifically, we are looking for someone with:

A Master’s or PhD degree (preferred) in natural hazards, geosciences, engineering, risk management or related fields
Several years of experience in natural hazard practice, applied research, public administration, consulting, engineering or industry, preferably but not necessarily in Switzerland
Strong expertise and understanding of natural hazards with demonstrated examples of dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Proven ability to identify important operational problems and translate them into actionable initiatives
With a track-record of successful collaborations in diverse teams and have demonstrated your excitement to not only do research but apply that research to the benefit of others.
Experience in mission, programme or applied R&D portfolio design
Strong project, portfolio and budget management skills with demonstrated examples of transparent reporting, dashboard and tracking tools for others to gain insights in these projects
Excellent stakeholder management skills across diverse public authorities, academia, industry and expert communities
The ability to work across disciplinary and organisational boundaries and to lead through influence
Strong judgement skills under uncertainty and the willingness to challenge established approaches constructively
Excellent communication and listening skills, and great presentation skills in various modalities
Excellent written and spoken English and German; French is an asset
You are mission-driven, entrepreneurial, a strong learner and comfortable working in a newly established and evolving organisation. You have a track-record of successful team participation and leadership and an excitement for hard and impactful work. You combine scientific credibility with pragmatic decision-making, economic awareness and a clear focus on adoption, operational relevance and measurable value. In doing so, you want to work on the best idea, not necessarily your best idea.

A rare opportunity to help build ETH Swiss GeoLab from its early phase and shape a new national initiative for Earth observation
A mission-driven role with high visibility and strong societal relevance
The opportunity to develop solutions for pressing natural hazard challenges in Switzerland, and with broad international impact through transferable methods and lessons learned
A workplace in Root/Lucerne, embedded in an active innovation ecosystem and closely connected to ETH Zurich
We look forward to receiving your online application with the following documents:

Your CV
Diplomas and work certificates
A short motivation statement outlining your interest in ETH Swiss GeoLab and the Natural Hazards Mission
A video (max 2 mins) about you and your motivation for this position
Please note that we exclusively accept applications submitted through the ETH Zurich online application portal. Applications via email or postal services will not be considered.

Further information about ETH Swiss GeoLab can be found on our website. Questions regarding the position should be directed to Dr Felix Seidel, Managing Director ETH Swiss GeoLab, felix.seidel@eaps.ethz.ch.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About us  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division (WP) at the University of Bern has been at the forefront of space research for over 50 years. Since conducting its first experiment on the Moon as part of the Apollo 11 mission, the division has participated in numerous missions led by major space agencies such as ESA, NASA, and JAXA.  
The Space Research and Planetary Sciences Division at the University of Bern is seeking a skilled and motivated Test or Electrical Engineer to support ongoing work with the ground reference model of NIM (Neutral and Ion Mass spectrometer), part of ESA's JUICE (JUpiter ICy moons Explorer) mission. title: Electromechanical Technical Engineer - Switzerland
description:
What you'll do:
High-temperature superconducting materials have interesting characteristics that make them suitable for future magnet applications. Come join CERN and take part in this exciting development.

You will develop and implement electromechanical systems for the manufacture and assembly of high-temperature superconducting (HTS) magnets, as part of an ongoing research and development (R&D) programme. Your work will involve coil winding and assembly, instrumentation and tooling, bringing together mechanical, electrical and control technologies.

Your responsibilities:
- Design and implement dedicated systems to produce high-temperature superconductor-based (HTS) coils, considering mechanical, electrical and control aspects, according to applicable safety regulations and industry standards.
- Conduct regular maintenance of machinery, electromechanical systems and technical infrastructure in the HTS magnet laboratory.
- Prepare technical documentation, including procedures, test and measurement reports, and ensure traceability of components.
- Coordinate component logistics and stock for assigned assemblies; initiate and follow up manufacturing requests and purchase orders.
- Perform or organise acceptance tests for manufactured components and assemblies.

Your profile:
- Hands-on experience in design and manufacture, assembly and maintenance of complex electromechanical equipment.
- Experience with quality documentation, including working with procedures, compiling tests and measurements reports and component traceability.
- Experience with computer-aided design (CAD) tools for electromechanical design would be an asset.
- Previous experience with superconducting systems would be an asset.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Electro-mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills:
- Design of electromechanical systems.
- Construction, test and installation of electromechanical equipment and systems.
- Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
- Knowledge of electrical machine technology.
- Assembly of mechanical structures and equipment.
- Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
- Takes responsibility for own actions and decisions.
- Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
- Listens actively to others and lets others speak.
- Produces workable and timely solutions that meet requirements.
- Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.

Employment conditions:
- A valid driving licence.
- Work in radiation controlled areas.
- Interventions in underground installations.

Ideal start date: 01/01/2027
Contract duration (in months): 60
Grade range: 4
Benchmark job: 301150 - Electromechanical Technical Engineer
Job flexibility: Fully Onsite

For more information about the position and application process, please visit: https://careers.cern/jobs/electromechanical-technical-engineer/
